description: Afterlove EP is a slice-of-life adventure about love, loss and music. Explore modern Jakarta as Rama in his journey to learn about himself, create music, find love and come to terms with the loss of his girlfriend Cinta, whose voice still lives on in his head.

title: MultiVersus
description:
MultiVersus is a free-to-play platform fighter that brings the depth of iconic WB stars to life across the nearly endless possibilities of play.

MultiVersus was taken offline permanently and delisted from storefronts on May 30, 2025, while remaining playable through its offline modes.

title: Storror Parkour Pro
description: Escape Reality. The ultimate multiplayer parkour experience. Escape, race, and explore the streets and rooftops of London’s Isle of Dogs. Join team STORROR to save your estate, or challenge your friends to test their skills. STORROR Parkour Pro is complete control and freedom of movement.

title: Dredge
description:
Dredge is a fishing adventure with a sinister undercurrent. Sell your catch, upgrade your vessel and dredge the depths for long-buried relics. Explore the stories of the strange locals and discover why some things are best left forgotten.
Captain your fishing trawler across a collection of remote islands, each with its own inhabitants to meet, wildlife to discover, and stories to unearth.

title: Renown
description: Renown is a multiplayer survival experience set in a vast and ever changing medieval world. Players begin with nothing, gathering resources, building a kingdom and fighting to survive in the hopes of becoming renowned across the land.

title: Survival Machine
description: Build your base on a machine in a constant motion, travel through biomes with different resources, and prepare for the night when a zombie threat is much higher than during a day. Would you go solo or explore this new world with your best friends?

title: I See Red
description: A frantic twin-stick shooter roguelite where you must rage through different spaceships filled with enemies. Steal their weapons, destroy every room, and use all you can find to attack. Are you strong enough to fulfill your revenge?

title: Star Wars: Hunters
description:
Star Wars: Hunters brings together all-new, unique Hunters from across the Star Wars galaxy each with larger-than-life personas, rich undiscovered pasts and ability sets that make them formidable combatants in The Arena.

Gear up for battle choosing from a roster of new characters, including nefarious bounty hunters, heroes of the Rebellion, Imperial stormtroopers, and everything in between. Outclass opponents by mastering advanced abilities, skills and strategies while fighting it out in intense 4v4 third-person combat and dominating opponents on the road to fame in The Arena.

Customize each Hunter by collecting and equipping them with fun and unique costumes, animations, and weapon appearances, making for an impressive competitor that stands out on the battlefield and is ready to challenge for glory.

Dazzle The Arena’s crowd, competing across multiple PVP game modes; within Escort, defense and attack skills are crucial as the team need to work together to safely escort the payload before their enemies defeat them. In Control, two teams battle it out to defeat one another and take control of the central objective area until the time runs out. Each battlefield set in The Grand Arena on Vespaara evokes iconic Star Wars locales such as Tatooine, Hoth and Endor.

title: Farthest Frontier
description: Protect and guide your people as you forge a town from untamed wilderness at the edge of the known world. Harvest raw materials, hunt, fish and farm to sustain your advancing town. Produce craft items for villagers to trade, consume, equip and fight with as you battle for your survival against the elements and outside threats.

title: Moroi
description: Moroi is a grimdark fairytale with an even darker sense of humor. Experience frantic combat, perplexing puzzles, and a twisting narrative anchored by a bizarre cast of characters. Can you break free from eternal madness?

title: Consume Me
description: did you feel stupid, fat, lazy, and ugly in high school? well i did...but at least i made a life-simulation RPG about it!

title: Builders of Egypt
description: Builders Of Egypt is a city-building economic strategy taking place in the Nile Valley. Immerse yourself in a world full of pyramids, where you will become a part of the ancient world. Create history, be history!

title: Sacre Bleu
description: You are a Musketeer imprisoned on false charges. Steam-blast your way out and find the evil-doers who framed you. Uncover a plot to take over France!

title: Ys IX: Monstrum Nox
description: While imprisoned in Balduq, Adol is cursed and becomes a Monstrum. With his newfound powers, he must stop the Grimwald Nox from consuming the city.

title: Deltarune: Chapter 1
description: The story follows a human named Kris who lives in a world inhabited by monsters. Kris and a classmate named Susie fall into an unknown place called the "Dark World" where they meet Ralsei, who informs them that they are heroes destined to save the world. The trio meets various beings who call themselves "Darkners" during a prophesied quest to seal the duplicate Dark Fountain. Mainly through the combat system, the player navigates through different kinds of bullet hell attacks by enemies, which can be resolved peacefully or through violence.

title: The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark
description: Delouse your room with sage and pack up your travel-sized ouija board, it's time to re-enter Twin Lakes - America's 34th most haunted city. Join Detective McQueen as he puzzles his way through 6 chilling cases, risking life and pixelated limb to solve the macabre mysteries that plague the poor town.

title: Pax Historia
description:
Pax Historia is an alternate-history sandbox game where players choose a country, a moment in time, and rewrite the course of history with the help of generative AI. What if Rome never fell? What if the Soviet Union survived? What if Genghis Khan ruled for another generation?

We go beyond history, too. What if aliens invaded Earth? What if you were a college dropout creating a tech startup? The ability to create, edit, and copy custom maps, actors, historical context, and more means that users can play nearly any scenario they can imagine

title: Kitten Space Agency
description: Kitten Space Agency is a mission to create the spaceflight game that inspires the next generation of space explorers.

title: Cure: A Hospital Simulator
description: Manage an ER during the apocalypse, solo or with friends online: diagnose patients, design and grow your hospital, and defend against the undead while treating the living. Integrate with Twitch chat for even more fun!

title: Courtroom Chaos: Starring Snoop Dogg
description:
Welcome to Courtroom Chaos! All rise for Judge Snoop Dogg!

Courtroom Chaos is what happens when your game night enters the courtroom. The cases may be fake, but the laughs are 100% real. You and your friends take turns improvising your testimony, inventing absurd characters, spinning wild stories, and defending the indefensible. And it’s all moderated by the dynamic, AI-powered Judge Snoop Dogg who holds court, challenges your team, and reacts contextually to your testimony, all before delivering his final verdict.

No gaming hardware. No scripts. Just your voice, your imagination, and whatever chaos you bring to the bench.

title: Tomb Raider: Anniversary
description:
This is an emulation of the classic PS2 action-adventure title, Tomb Raider: Anniversary, playable on PS4 and PS5 for the first time and enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Tomb Raider: Anniversary is a third-person action-adventure game that revisits Lara Croft’s original journey to recover the Scion artifact. It reimagines the 1996 title with updated environments, refined controls, and expanded narrative elements while maintaining the exploration, platforming, and combat of the original game.

title: Super Mario Galaxy
description: This second Nintendo Switch port of Super Mario Galaxy was released standalone and contains differences from the Super Mario 3D All-Stars version, such as an Assist Mode and extra pages in Rosalina's Storybook.

title: The Silence After
description: The Silence After is a first-person atmospheric horror game where you play as a blind sole survivor following a distress signal through an apocalyptic reality, interacting with the environment and using your synesthetic ability to perceive sound as color to progress and avoid death.

title: NBA Bounce
description: Step onto the court with your favorite NBA team and mascots. Dribble, dunk, unlock gear, and play solo or with friends in fun game modes.

title: Bleak Haven
description: Bleak Haven is a cinematic survival horror where faith is twisted, every shot matters, and survival hangs on what you can build. Explore haunted ruins, abandoned villages, and face a cult preparing the world for a god no one should ever witness.

title: Chaos Zero Nightmare
description: Chaos Zero Nightmare is a cosmic loop RPG. The official has announced that Chaos Zero Nightmare will come to us soon. Some glimpses of character animations were shown in the teaser, evoking a similar 2D art and animation style to Epic Seven.

title: Resident Evil 3: Nemesis
description:
A port of Resident Evil 3 Nemesis, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

Resident Evil 3: Nemesis is a survival horror video game and the third instalment in the Resident Evil series. Like its two predecessors, it is a third-person action-adventure game with polygonal characters on pre-rendered backgrounds with cinematic camera angles. Although the game uses the same basic engine and gameplay as the previous games, the gameplay is improved by features such as auto-targeting, a 180-degree spin, and a new dodge move that allows Jill to avoid enemy attacks.

title: Monsters Are Coming!
description: Beware, monsters are coming! In this Tower-Survivor rogue-lite, you protect an ever-moving city from unrelenting hordes. Gather resources, fortify defenses, and boost potential through enhanced player progression. Will you reach the Arch?

title: Project Reboot
description:
Project Reboot is a fan-made remaster of Pixel Worlds brought to you by the community! Made for everyone by everyone.

Fully Free-To-Play with zero in-game transactions.

title: Mimesis
description: A co-op survival horror game. When the cursed rain falls, 'Mimesis' appear, perfectly imitating your teammates, bringing a new level of tension you've never experienced before.

title: S.p.l.i.t
description: A short psychological horror game, where you attempt to gain root access into an unethical superstructure.

title: BlazBlue: Entropy Effect x Dead Cells
description:
New Playable Character (Prototype) – The Prisoner
Step into the boots of the iconic Prisoner from Dead Cells, wield 27 signature weapons, skills and mutations from the original game as well as 20+ combo variants that pay tribute to other Dead Cells’ iconic gears.
Exclusive Challenge Biome
Dive into a new roguevania-inspired challenge biome built for The Prisoner, where Dead Cells’ fast, fluid combat meets BBEE’s satisfying combos!

title: Witchy Business
description: Manage your very own Witchcraft Shop. This is a job simulator game where you brew potions for your customers, collect oddities, grow flowers in your garden, upgrade your alchemy station, and thrive.

title: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2
description:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2 is an action fighting game based on the Demon Slayer series.

It follows the events of the anime, continuing the story of Tanjiro Kamado and his companions. Players take part in arena-based battles using characters with distinct moves and abilities. The game includes a story mode and versus modes for local and online play. It expands on the mechanics and roster introduced in the original Hinokami Chronicles.

title: Trident's Tale
description: Uncover the secrets of the Storm Trident and rule the seas - Your legend awaits in Trident's Tale!

title: LAN Party Adventures
description: Okay, Pedro is AWOL, and you have to get this LAN Party set up at the Game Store for the session later. Connect cables, install software, and solve puzzles all while you and the gang uncover the mystery of your missing friend.

title: Among Us 3D
description: Teamwork and betrayal in space… now in 3D! In this party game, Crewmates work together to complete tasks before one or more Impostors kill everyone aboard. Experience all of the same deception and deceit as the original Among Us in all three dimensions.

title: Stellar Blade x Goddess of Victory: Nikke
description: Worlds collide in an epic cross-over of heroic proportions in this add-on expansion for Stellar Blade featuring mini games, a new Boss showdown and unlockable cosmetics from mobile app GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE.

title: Static Dread: The Lighthouse
description: Lovecraft meets Papers, Please. Play as a lighthouse keeper and guide ships safely into the harbor using your radio. Survive the presence of something impossible, and don’t let the shadows consume you!

title: Locomoto
description: Locomoto is a cozy, life-sim adventure game set on a train, where you are the conductor! Customise and manage your train, while tending to your colourful passengers. Get onboard and embark on a journey through beautiful landscapes, accompanied by a soft, lofi original soundtrack.

title: Nice Day for Fishing
description: The world needs you Adventurer! Embark on an RPG pixel adventure where you’ll play as Baelin the humble fisherman, who must rise-up to become the hero of Honeywood. Battle fish with precision timing and magic spells, upgrade your abilities, defeat evil and rebuild Honeywood.

title: Effulgence RPG
description: Effulgence is a party-based RPG in a sci-fi setting. Players will explore a distant, possibly extinct world, battle its hostile inhabitants, craft gear, and develop their characters. All graphics in Effulgence are made of text symbols, making it visually unique.

title: True Nightmare: Roadside Сafe
description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a night-shift waitress at a secluded roadside café, serve strange patrons and feel mounting dread. Each night, the nightmare becomes more real, and someone is watching from the darkness. Can you survive?

title: Poppy Playtime: Chapter 4 - Safe Haven
description:
Brace yourself for the darkest chapter yet in the epic Poppy Playtime saga.

You are pushed deeper into the undiscovered depths of the Playtime Co. factory, far below anything the world knew. Here, you’ll encounter terrifying new threats and discover shocking revelations. Can you outwit the unnatural new creations lurking in the shadows? Can you survive here long enough to eventually unravel the mysteries behind the experiments? Every step will test your courage, every puzzle will challenge your mind, and every corner may be your last.

Will you escape the horrors hidden within Playtime Co., or will you succumb to the terror? Survival isn’t guaranteed. Fear is.

title: Venus Vacation Prism: Dead or Alive Xtreme
description:
On this island, the moment of love.

The first ever full-fledged first-person adventure romance game in the DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme series, offering romantic encounters with six cute, charming girls!

title: Hitman World of Assassination: VR Access
description:
Become the ultimate HITMAN in VR.

Walk in the crowded streets of Mumbai, explore the corridors of a Parisian palace, or stalk your target through the jungles of Colombia, in VR these environments become worlds you inhabit.

Imagine standing in the center of a bustling marketplace, feeling the energy of the crowd around you, or peering through the scope of a sniper rifle, your heartbeat syncing with the pulse of the trigger. Every moment feels more intense and personal.

With NEW INTUITIVE CONTROLS, interact with the world around you, use your hands to perform every action, and feel the tension of every mission.

Jump into thrilling action with DUAL-WIELDING, allowing you to hold weapons in both hands.

title: Deadzone: Rogue
description: Deadzone: Rogue is a roguelite first-person shooter set in deep space. Slay hordes of enemies, loot powerful gear, and customize your loadout during each unique run. Uncover fragments of your past as you piece together the truth behind your mission. Fight. Die. Revive. Repeat.

title: Monster Prom 4: Monster Con
description: Can you find love at the nerdiest convention ever? "Monster Con" goes back to the multiplayer dating sim formula: go through absurd and funny situations as you find love among six sexy monsters! Who will you romance? The mimic who cosplays? The idol clown? Or the eldritch cutie? (There's also Liam)

title: Ila: A Frosty Glide
description:
Set foot on a magical island and immerse yourself in a whimsical small open world as ILA, a spirited young witch-in-training with her trusty skatebroom. Explore, find secret places, collectables, and improve your magic and flying abilities as you make your way to the summit.

Explore a whimsical small open world as ILA, a spirited young witch-in-training. Start your journey fueled by determination and your trusty skatebroom. Find secret places, collect valuable items, and improve your magical flying abilities.

Who needs a broom when you have a skatebroom? Soar through snowy mountains and enchanted forests, feel the wind as you cross stunning landscapes. Master and upgrade the magic of your to soar higher and farther.

Explore ILA’s small open world at your own pace and relax. Find hidden nooks, uncover treasures, and unlock secrets flying on your skatebroom. Each discovery rewards you with valuable items and deeper lore, enriching your magical journey.

Collect special items and coins to personalize ILA’s outfit with stylish hats, capes, and skatebrooms to reflect your unique style. As you progress, access new skatebroom upgrades to improve ILA’s flying powers.

Feel the magic and enjoy the captivating original soundtrack composed by Joaquim Scandurra (Sku), which builds up and grows with you as you approach the summit.

title: Squeakross: Home Squeak Home
description: In Squeakross: Home Squeak Home, solve and transform puzzles into furniture to decorate the perfect home for your rodent friend. Collect hundreds of decorations, accessories and stickers in this cozy game full of charm!

title: Painted In Blood
description: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

title: Cabin Crew Life Simulator
description: Welcome to Cabin Crew Simulator, the pioneering flight attendant simulator by SOGA Std. Dive into the glamorous world of aviation and kickstart your career by ensuring passenger satisfaction and safety. Navigate through exciting tasks on each flight, from serving gourmet meals to managing in-flight emergencies, providing an unparalleled passenger experience.

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Thrown to the Dogs
description: Thrown to the Dogs is a downloadable content pre-order expansion package for Assassin's Creed: Shadows that is expected to release alongside the main game. It will involve helping a loyal dog avenge his late master.

title: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
description: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Norse Gods, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

title: Undusted: Letters from the Past
description: Undusted: Letters from the Past is a casual game focused on restoring dirty items to their pristine state. Use a variety of tools to return objects to their original appearance. As you clean each item belonging to the protagonist, reflect on the significance and stories behind them.

title: Sector Unknown
description: Sector Unknown is a solo-developed, isometric sci-fi RPG set in a shadowy expanse of space. Begin on a desolate planet, establish a stronghold, explore space, ally with or dominate local factions, and combat a despotic organization set on ruthlessly exploiting the sector's resources and inhabitants.

title: Void War
description: Command an ancient starship and fight your way to the heart of a dying Empire. Fend off attacks from demented cultists, craven space pirates, and xenophobic Imperial soldiers. Discover powerful artifacts and use them to build your ship into a fearsome war engine.

title: Echoes of Yi: Samsara
description: "Echoes of Yi : Samsara" is a hard-core martial arts action game that incorporates elements of traditional Chinese culture. In the game, players play a martial arts character who prevents disasters in the world and restores stability and peace to one side.

title: The August Before
description: The August Before is a meditative narrative 3D puzzle about cleaning up, sorting out and packing up your life before moving on. Clean up and don’t forget your old belongings on your way to the new life!

title: Silent North
description: Silent North thrusts you into the Swiss Alps, battling the elements, Infected, and other players. Fight solo or team up, scavenging gear and essentials. Intense PVPVE action ensures constant danger. Adapt, be resilient, and survive in this unpredictable, ever-changing landscape.

title: Deltarune: Chapter 3
description: A chapter for Deltarune. It released alongside chapter 4.

title: Ravenous Horde
description: Kill hordes of zombies as a hunter, and kill hunters when you're a zombie! In this round based multiplayer post-apocalyptic FPS you start as a hunter, and turn into a zombie when you die. Level up and unlock perks, new weapons and customization options!

title: Memoriapolis
description: Memoriapolis is a historical city builder where your city grows organically across 5 ages, from Antiquity to the Industrial Revolution. Manage resources, interact with factions, and shape your dynasty toward building a final Wonder with easy, normal, or hard difficulty levels.

title: Dreamcore
description: Step into the surreal with Dreamcore, a body-cam styled psychological horror game that plunges you into the eerie beauty of "liminal spaces." Unravel the mysteries of Dreamcore’s non-linear worlds and uncover its hidden secrets. Can you discover what lies beyond the edge of reality?

title: Ascend
description: Ascend is an adventure puzzle game where a young woman must navigate to the top of a mystical mountain learning the secrets of both the past and the future to find the balance in all aspects of life.

title: Rogue Labyrinth
description: Fight through the ranks in a monster-filled labyrinth created by an egocentric billionaire colonist. Make friends (or enemies) with rivals, employees, fans, and monsters to improve your abilities. The crowd wants a show, so hype them up in this rogue-lite narrative adventure!

title: Hordes of Hunger
description: Hordes of Hunger is a fast-paced action arena slasher with rogue-lite elements set in the dark fantasy setting of Ismer. A land engulfed by the living hunger, the cosmic horror known only as the Beast. You are the unlucky one still living inside the nightmare and the only way out is through it.

title: Project Tower
description: Dive in Project Tower, a third-person shooter mixing intense bullet hell combat with a unique morphing ability. Imprisoned by the "Hiks", fight to the top of their deadly tower for freedom. Will you outsmart them and make your way out ?

title: MakeRoom
description: Build rooms, gardens, and camper vans with 1,100+ objects and the ability to make your own furniture from scratch. Learn with gentle design requests, then relax and create at your own pace.

title: Ascent of Ashes
description: A colony sim set in a post-apocalyptic dystopia. Build and defend your base. Manage your survivors. Engage raiders, aliens, Remnant soldiers and other factions in real-time-with-pause combat. Or use stealth to outwit them. Explore the massive world. Survive at all costs

title: Death Relives
description: Be prepared for a first-person look on life through the eyes of a teenager, who is trying to escape from mighty Aztec god Xipe Totec. Get ready for a chaotic experience with horror and survival mechanics.

title: Sword: Depths of the Void
description: Sword: Depths of the Void is WorthyWorm and The Sword Teams first upcoming game, releasing in 2025. Sword: Depths of the Void is a 2D Action RPG Platformer with a special sword that can morph it's blade into different weapons. Play as Trent Helms, the chosen one of this legendary sword, and make your way through various areas in open-world forms, bring people with you on your journey, explore a town in the sky, and much, much more.

title: Day of the Shell
description: Day of the Shell is a “one-click, one-turn” tactical rogue-lite. In a shattered and flooded world, travel from island to island with only hope and a revolver, challenging and appeasing the gods.

title: Dark Atlas: Infernum
description: If Hell is a state of the soul, this story is the descent to the inner abyss. Dark Atlas: Infernum is a disturbing first-person story , where the end of the world is combined with psychological terror in a survival horror experience with a strong narrative component.

title: PaperKlay
description: PaperKlay is a short and sweet 3D platformer where you unfold, open and rotate the paper environment in order to freely explore the cardboard world.

title: Old Skies
description: A time travel adventure spanning two hundred years! Dive into the past with time agent Fia Quinn as she embarks on seven trips through time. History is up for grabs, from the speakeasies of Prohibition to the vicious gangs of the Gilded Age to the World Trade Center on September 10, 2001.

title: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley
description: Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley is a musical adventure game in which Snufkin needs to restore the harmony of Moominvalley, after a series of grotesque parks has appeared and ruined the valley's natural balance. The game is an ambient and wholesome experience for both kids and adults, and combines open world-mechanics with puzzles, stealth and melodic elements.

title: Tormentor
description: Take on the role of a merciless torturer. Earn money from video transmissions of your torments and then buy new victims and torture tools to expand your prison.

title: Outbreak Island
description: Survive on a remote Island, where a mysterious Outbreak awakens bloodthirsty monsters at night. Craft, build and defend your base in the brutal world of Outbreak Island, an open-world sandbox survival horror game.

title: Afterblast
description: Afterblast is a challenging FPS rogue-lite action game. Play solo or in co-op. Features dynamic gameplay with randomly generated dungeons, so don't hesitate to obtain the power, unlock new loot, and find a way to save your planet. Stand up against the gods and fight against hordes of monsters.

title: Robin Hood: Sherwood Builders
description: Robin Hood - Sherwood Builders is an action-adventure RPG with base-building elements, where you take on the role of a classic hero who stands up to the tyranny and injustice that haunts Sherwood. Fight, craft, steal, and of course help the local people grow and prosper.

title: Out and About
description: You've come to help your Granny after a terrible storm destroyed her cottage and wreaked havoc in her idyllic coastal town. Can you find a way of restoring her home and uniting the townsfolk? Connect with nature by foraging, gardening, and cooking, then try out your new skills in the real world!

title: Splatoon 3
description: Enter the Splatlands, a sun-scorched desert inhabited by battle-hardened Inklings and Octolings. Splatsville, the city of chaos, is the adrenaline-fueled heart of this dusty wasteland. Even in this desolate environment, Turf War reigns supreme and battles rage in new stages located in the surrounding wilds. Dynamic new moves help these fighters dodge attacks and cover more ground, along with a new bow-shaped weapon to sling ink.

title: Dungeon Rampage
description: Dungeon Rampage is an action MMO. Players can unlock and play different characters in Diablo-style combat, utilize powerful weapons, and enable various character skins for increased customization. Bash, stab, cook, and shock enemies into submission as you explore random maps alone, with friends, or with other members of the community in this fast-paced dungeon crawler.

title: Viewfinder
description: Viewfinder is a puzzle game where you can reshape the world around you by taking photos with an instant camera.

title: Creature Keeper
description: Creature Keeper is a top-down action-adventure RPG where you can befriend wild creatures and raise them to fight alongside you! Scout the creatures of the world and build up your dream team! Cook foods to strengthen your creatures and craft trinkets from the materials grown in your pocket garden. Learn skills from your strongest to help you take on bigger creatures.

title: Slender Threads
description: Slender Threads is a point-and-click thriller adventure where unseen forces bind the fate of an unremarkable traveling salesman to the peculiar town he one day arrives in.

title: Cowboy Life Simulator
description: In the 19th century in the Wild West, you are a poor farmer wanting something more from life: you want an adventure. Sit on a horse and become a Cowboy, unfortunately it won't be that easy because many dangers await on that path and you are no hero yet.

title: Naïca
description: Naica is a 8bit Fantasy cross-platfrom MMORPG where you take on the role of a lowly adventurer trying to assist those in peril. Fight, collect or explore what the world of Naica has to offer, secrets lie behind every corner. The world needs your help adventurer, will you answer the call?

title: Blacksmith Simulator
description: Become a Medieval blacksmith in this interactive blacksmithing simulator. Upgrade your forging equipment, unlock new exotic crafting materials, grow your business, and manage your customers - in addition to engaging forging mechanics. Strike while the iron is hot and hop in front of the forge now!

title: The Messenger
description:
As a demon army besieges his village, a young ninja ventures through a cursed world, to deliver a scroll paramount to his clan's survival.
Leveraging players expectations as a core game design ingredient, The Messenger is first presented as an 8-bit action platformer with a simple story, that unravels into an epic time traveling tale, eventually revealing itself as a 16-bit Metroidvania game packed with replay value and deadpan humor.

title: Doki Doki Literature Club!
description: The Literature Club is full of cute girls! Will you write the way into their heart? This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

title: TimeSplitters Rewind
description:
TimeSplitters Rewind is a standalone, fan-developed first-person shooter that serves as a comprehensive tribute to the classic TimeSplitters franchise. Developed by Cinder Interactive using Unreal Engine, the project aggregates and remakes content, including maps, characters, and weapons, from TimeSplitters, TimeSplitters 2, and TimeSplitters: Future Perfect into a single cohesive experience.

The game features modern graphical enhancements while strictly preserving the fast-paced, arcade-style gameplay mechanics of the originals. Key features include online multiplayer support for up to 10 players, extensive bot support, and a fully playable recreation of the original TimeSplitters campaign with co-op functionality. TimeSplitters Rewind is a non-profit project released as a completely free-to-play title.

title: Arms
description:
Arms, a mix of boxing and shooting where you use extendable arms to battle your friends both locally and online! Take a Joy-Con in each hand and punch forward, twisting your fists to bend your attacks.

"Choose a fighting champion from around the world, equip your own combination of extendable arms, and then use a mix of button presses and quick hand motions to really take the fight to your opponent. Throw punches and guide them midflight to hit agile fighters, avoid incoming attacks with dashes, or trampoline high into the air to rain down fists from above. Power-up your punches to deal extra damage or curve your fists around obstacles to hit skittish opponents. Fill up your special gauge to dish out devastating combinations and finish them off. Unleash your inner fighter in this unbelievable sporting event! "

title: Dusk
description: Battle through an onslaught of mystical backwater cultists, possessed militants and even darker forces as you attempt to discover just what lurks beneath the earth in this retro FPS inspired by all your 90's favorites. Featuring a full single player campaign, endless survival mode and classic arena multiplayer.

title: Subnautica
description: Descend into the depths of an alien underwater world filled with wonder and peril. Craft equipment, pilot submarines and out-smart wildlife to explore lush coral reefs, volcanoes, cave systems, and more, all while trying to survive.

title: Black Desert
description:
Black Desert is a game that tests the limitations of MMORPG
by implementing remastered graphics and audio. Enjoy exciting combat and siege,
exploration, trading, fishing, training, alchemy, cooking, gathering, hunting, and more in the vast open world.

title: Call of Blood
description:
The game takes place in 2009-2011.

Call of Blood is a cinematic single-player first-person shooter that immerses you in a gritty survival experience. The world is engulfed in a zombie outbreak, but the walking dead are far from your only problem.

You became the most wanted target after eliminating an influential politician who launched three dangerous reactors that could kill half of humanity.

Now, regular groups of enemies and elite operatives from the (Vurs) are hunting your head. A group of scientists is the only key to salvation. They offer you the dangerous deal of a lifetime: break through the cordon and blow up the sinister reactors from the inside.

title: Mine Defense
description: Mine Defense is a 2D action-adventure game inspired by sandbox survival games. Explore a dangerous world, gather resources, craft weapons and equipment, fight hostile creatures, and build your own base. Progress through the game by discovering new materials, improving your gear, and facing increasingly powerful enemies and bosses.

title: Under Heaven or Hell
description:
You wake up in Hell with no memory of how you got there, and no clear way out.

To return home, you will have to survive the brutal politics of this realm and forge alliances with two dangerous devils and an enigmatic angel, each with their own secrets, and temptations that may pull you closer.

Will you escape with your soul intact, or will your path become forever tied to those who linger within the flames?

Your choices will shape your fate, and perhaps, the fate of Hell itself.

title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A - Mega Dimension
description: Mysterious distortions have appeared without warning in Lumiose City. They seem to connect to a space known as Hyperspace Lumiose...and the mythical Pokémon Hoopa might have some part to play.

title: Allumeria
description: Explore a vast and hazardous cave network and uncover mountains of loot. Build a town and trade with NPCs using advanced building and lighting tools. Fight bosses and raid dungeons to unlock abilities. Play with your friends, and build, fight, thrive, in the fully destructible world of Allumeria!

title: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II: Legacy of the Forge
description: Put your blacksmithing skills to the test to repair a legendary burnt-down forge. Establish your own home in the heart of Kuttenberg, designing the forge, its surroundings and private quarters with the ability to customise and furnish to aid your gameplay.

title: World of Tanks 2.0
description: Start the next chapter of World of Tanks in the interactive Operations Room—a central place to reflect on your journey, prepare for what's ahead, and gear up for Update 2.0

title: Black Souls II
description:
BLACK SOULS II is the censored release of the Dark Fairy Tale Fantasy x Psychological Horror RPG focusing on the themes of "Exploration of a Mad World" and "Life or Death Combat against Demonbeasts".

Despair. Fear, Madness, once again. An original work based on "Alice in Wonderland" and "Through the Looking-Glass."

title: Battlefield 6: Phantom Edition
description:
The Phantom Edition is an upgraded version of Battlefield 6.

It includes:
BF Pro Token: grants the first Battle Pass, 25 tier skips, and exclusive unlocks.
Phantom Pack: a collection of cosmetic items such as 4 soldier skins, two weapon skins, a melee knife skin, a vehicle skin, a weapon sticker, a weapon charm, and a dog tag.
Phantom XP Boost Set: temporary boosts for weapon and career XP rates.
Pre-order Bonus (Tombstone Pack): includes cosmetic items and XP boosts regardless of edition

title: Rust Mobile
description:
The globally renowned PC survival game is coming to mobile!

Officially licensed by Rust developer Facepunch Studios, Rust Mobile faithfully recreates the high-risk, high-reward, unpredictable open world of the original, while being optimized for an even better experience on mobile.

Intense PvP warfare, base raiding, crafting and survival... Whether you're at home, commuting, or on a quick break, you can jump straight into the world of Rust.

Rust Mobile retains everything players love about the PC version: open-world exploration, heart-pounding PvP combat, base building, and emergent social gameplay. Now, it's all coming to mobile. The game features a fully explorable sandbox world with dynamic weather, regional biomes, and a real-time day-night cycle. The core loop of Rust remains - loot, craft, raid, die and start over - so every choice you make matters.

Your survival journey on mobile starts now!

title: Super Mario Bros. Remastered
description: Super Mario Bros. Remastered is an unofficial PC remake of the 1985 NES classic. It features enhanced graphics, widescreen support, smoother gameplay, custom resource packs, a level editor, and bonus content like The Lost Levels.

title: Out of Time
description: Out of Time is a fast-paced, multi-player co-op roguelike where your squad, gear, and teamwork decide survival. Battle through a fractured world where past, present, and future collide - facing swarms of corrupted enemies, brutal bosses, and chaotic mini-games all before time runs out.

title: My Little Cafe Nightmare
description: Brew otherworldly coffee for ghostly patrons in a dark, cozy first-person café. Upgrade your shop, manage supplies, and turn a haunted café into a sanctuary amidst nightmares.

title: Age of Mythology: Retold - Heavenly Spear
description: Unleash 12 new gods in a mythic Japanese campaign and multiplayer. Command powerful samurai, shadowy ninjas and creatures from Japanese mythology in this epic expansion.

title: Blade & Soul Heroes
description: This thrilling free-to-play Collectible Action MMORPG offers the duality of turn-based strategy & real-time action. Experience exciting cross-platform play and embark on an epic quest where numerous stories are waiting to be discovered alongside your five member team. Unite your heroes!

title: Star Ores Inc.
description: Take over an abandoned space station and run your own ore mine. Carve your way through the asteroid with your laser, sell ore, and create an automated network of robot helpers to maximize your profit.

title: Resident Evil 2
description: Resident Evil 2 is a remake of 1998's Resident Evil 2. The game was not developed with the intent of improving the original, but rather a reimagining of the original story with redesigned maps, characters and story elements. Gameplay mechanics are more similar to Resident Evil 7: Biohazard though with the use of an over-the-shoulder camera.

title: Twisted Metal 4
description: A digital re-edition of Twisted Metal 4, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Twisted Metal III
description: A digital re-edition of Twisted Metal III, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Deus Ex: The Conspiracy
description: The year is 2052 and the world is a dangerous and chaotic place. Terrorists operate openly - killing thousands; drugs, disease and pollution kill even more. The world's economies are close to collapse and the gap between the insanely wealthy and the desperately poor grows ever wider. Worst of all, an ages old conspiracy bent on world domination has decided that the time is right to emerge from the shadows and take control.

title: Hordelord
description: Hordelord is a hi-octane arena mobility shooter (horde & endless modes) where you face waves of nasty enemies. Armed with powerful weapons and high-mobility skills, zip around and fight to achieve the highest score on global leaderboards. Hordelord sports tight gunplay, satisfying kills, and meaningful upgrades.

title: Umami
description: Umami is a cozy 3D food puzzle game where every level is a handcrafted, sensory experience. Tinker, rotate, and fit wooden blocks together to build mouthwatering food towers and fantastical cakes, all in a comfy atmosphere, like tidying a bento box for the soul.

title: Side Effects
description: Side Effects is a horror game that attempts to re-design Russian Roulette, replacing the gun and bullets with pills.

title: Spooky Express
description: Plan the train route for the world’s spookiest theme park! Transport monsters to their destinations — but don’t let them bite the passengers or you’ll have a grave problem.

title: Mr Farmboy
description: MR FARMBOY is a cute colony farming automation game. Plant, grow, harvest, raise animals, hire workers, gather, craft, automate, and build a beautiful farm for villagers to visit.

title: It Has My Face
description: Kill your clone before it kills YOU! In this roguelite sandbox horror game, experience true paranoia as you hide, hunt, and try to eliminate your double. Fight to survive as you unravel this terrifying tale of clones and biological horrors!

title: Destiny 2: Renegades
description: Dive into the criminal underworld and take down an evil empire. Venture into a lawless frontier and reveal deeper mysteries about a new Dredgen in Sol. Build your power, credits, and notoriety.

title: Gamblers Table
description:
Gamblers Table is an idle automation game where you toss coins to earn money. Buy bigger and better coins, unlock upgrades and hire little helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy flipping work for you. Simple. Satisfying.

Click a coin to toss it. Every time it lands on Heads, you earn money.

The more coins you own, the more you can flip. Buy upgrades to make them flip faster and yield more money. Discover curious interactions and unexpected synergies between different coin types.

Hire little helpers to take care of all the manual labour for you. They don’t complain, and they never question.

Leave your fortune behind and rise to something greater. Start again with peculiar new talents you didn’t have before.

Admire your riches, lean back, and watch your automated coin-flipping empire grow.

title: She's Leaving
description: Put your forensic skills to the test in this brand new first person survival horror, She's Leaving. Play as Charles Dalton, a blood spatter analyst tasked with the most gruesome crime scene of his life. Can you survive a night in House Haywood?

title: Playtown 3
description: Thirteen years later, Playtown reopens, but it's no longer just a playground. Uncover the dark rise of the enigmatic E.Y.E. Order, battle terrifying mutated mascots, and stop Hexcor before his plan destroys everything. The truth lies beneath. Survive the nightmare. End the Order.

title: Cucina Stellata
description:
Gastronomy meets horror in an unsettling narrative experience set in 19th-century Romagna, Italy.

Step into the shoes of a solitary writer and gourmet, inspired by the historical figure of Pellegrino Artusi, as a midnight snack spirals into the unexpected.

Cucina Stellata ✦ Starred Cuisine isn't your typical horror game: no frantic chases or cheap jump scares, but rather a thick atmosphere of tension, disturbing themes, and chilling twists that will linger in your mind long after the credits roll.

title: Nidana
description: She continues to dream. A first-person dream simulator where you explore a corner of a dream.

title: Femboy Futa House
description: Congratulations, you've been accepted to the College of Magical Arts! Immerse yourself in a rich student life full of magic, passion, and adventure. Meet the eccentric residents of dorm 9 ¾ and get to know them as closely as you can...

title: Driving Life
description: Driving Life is a hardcore driving survival game set in rural America. Earn money by driving manual cars, vans, and trucks, transport tourists, pay rent, buy fuel, and survive on a tight budget. Every dollar counts - spend wisely or go broke!

title: Carimara: Beneath the Forlorn Limbs
description: You are the Carimara, and your mission is to conjure a ghost by answering their questions using your cards. A short and creepy fairytale, full of surprises and mysteries.

title: Tamagotchi Plaza: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
description:
The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of Tamagotchi Plaza adds three exclusive shops that can be played with mouse controls.

Become a shopkeeper in Tamahiko Town. Engage with more than 100 Tamagotchi as they open, customize and grow more than a dozen different shops and improve your reputation with them in town.

title: Huntsman
description: Trapped inside a spider-infested research facility, Huntsman immerses you in a survival horror experience fueled by arachnophobia. Combining realistic spider behavior with intense tension, Huntsman will test your nerve like never before.

title: Fresh Tracks
description: Jump, dodge, and fight to the rhythm of the gods in this thrilling music-action game on skis. Take on obstacles and menacing enemies as you ski further into the darkness that has befallen the snow-covered land of Norwyn.

title: How 2 Escape: Lost Submarine
description: Team up with a friend to reach a lost submarine and prevent the outbreak of war. Work together on two devices to solve increasingly challenging puzzles, where each of you has your own unique role to play.

title: Seafarer: The Ship Sim
description: Embark on the ultimate maritime experience with Seafarer: The Ship Sim. Choose between careers, take the helm of a variety of ships, and expand your fleet. Navigate a vast open world and become immersed in the beautiful expanses and rolling waves.

title: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4
description: Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4 is a remake of the original Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 4, bundled in the Tony Hawk's Pro Skater 3+4 collection.

title: Gothic 1 Remake: Nyras Prologue
description: Welcome to the Colony – an exclusive stand-alone prologue to the Gothic 1 Remake. Take your first step into the world of this genre-defining classic RPG by experiencing an entirely new story: the first day of a fresh inmate in the prison colony.

title: Devolve Online
description: An action MMORPG third-person shooter that blends classic MMORPG persistent progression with short, session-based challenges where hundreds of players fight for growth at once, seamlessly integrated into the dynamic, expansive, ongoing game world.

title: Eyes of Hellfire
description: Eyes of Hellfire is a co-op gothic horror game. Hoist the candelabra and, along with your friends, step into the darkened halls of the Hellfire Club.

title: Cozy Organizer
description: Organize, decorate, align, and stack items in cozy environments.

title: Detective: Rainy Night
description: Detective Rainy Night is a psychological horror narrative adventure with elements of deduction. Violent crimes, mature stories, and a touch of horror await you at the Motel Holiday. Grab a pencil and paper because solving this case won’t be easy.

title: Wrap House Simulator
description: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

title: Hack and Climb
description:
"Hack And Climb" is a physics-based 2D Foddian platformer where every swing matters!
Play as a cursed axe on a grueling ascent in search of revenge
Hard, fair, and addictively fun!

title: DeadWire
description: Hack, link, and shoot in a fast-paced top-down cyberpunk shooter. Create devastating chain reactions to outwit enemies, break records and save your childhood mentor from a ruthless syndicate

title: Darkest Days
description: Action, Adventure, Massively Multiplayer, RPG, Free To Play

title: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater - Digital Deluxe Edition
description:
The Digital Deluxe Edition includes both the game and the Sneaking DLC Pack at a reduced price.
Includes:
・METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER
・Sneaking DLC Pack
Uniform: Battle Dress (PW ver.)​
Uniform: Sneaking Suit (PW ver.)​
Uniform: Crocodile Suit​
Uniform: Naked (Woodland)​
Uniform: Naked (Ammunition Belt)
Uniform: Gold
Face: Glasses
Face: Sunglasses
Equipment: Kerotan Mask
Equipment: GA-KO Mask

title: Hell Is Us: Deluxe Edition
description:
The Deluxe Edition of Hell Is Us includes:
- The Hollow Walker Pack, featuring an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI
- The Military Pack, featuring an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI
- An exclusive investigation
- The Art Pack, including the digital artbook and original soundtrack

title: Patapon 3
description: Patapon 3 is a rhythm game for the PlayStation Portable now back on modern consoles.

title: Benny Bash
description: Survive this horror/puzzle adventure. Uncover the secrets of a cursed video game from the '80s while a malevolent entity hunts you. Solve escape room-style puzzles, navigate eerie labyrinths, and see how your actions in the game shape the real world. Stay sharp... and stay alive.

title: GeckoShop
description: Collect and sell geckos. Decorate and upgrade your shop. Chase Thieves. Explore the small open-world city, full of charm and life. Sell your lizards, or keep 'em as your Pets!

title: Heart Electric
description: Stay one step ahead of the shifting balance of power in this 4-team Hero FPS. Heart Electric challenges you to outwit, outplay, and ultimately eliminate three other teams. Tactics, team play, and unpredictability are as important as sharp aim in this innovative hero shooter.

title: Suikoden II HD Remaster: Dunan Unification War
description: Remaster of the second Suikoden game, released as part of the Suikoden I & II HD Remaster: Gate Rune and Dunan Unification Wars bundle.

title: Black Armor: Battle For Survivors
description:
In a world on the brink of chaos, Black Armor, Spicy, Charlie and other heroes fight to maintain balance, while the Grim Reaper and his dark forces threaten to destroy everything. Prepare for a story full of bravery, betrayal and redemption, where every fight counts.

Experience the most visceral and challenging combat. Don't miss it!

title: The Scouring
description: The Scouring is an RTS with fast pace, high attention to detail and next generation experience. Lead humans or orcs to fight for victory! Play alone or with friends. Use modding tools to create custom game modes! Join The battle!

title: A Game About Digging A Hole
description: A minimalist game about digging a hole in the garden of a newly purchased house. Collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and discover a mysterious secret. Costs you only one coffee!

title: Do No Harm
description: A Doctor Simulator with a Lovecraftian twist. Diagnose patients by analyzing unsettling symptoms and treat them using your Book of Medicine. Make moral choices — decide who to save or kill, discover whom to trust, and unlock multiple endings! Can you endure 30 days of perilous decisions?

title: Starlight Re:Volver
description: Dive into vibrant dream worlds, where every adventure brings you closer to Nishi stardom. Team up to unleash explosive combos and defeat powerful foes. Then, unwind in the lively city of NIM, where you can hang-out, craft and relax with friends.

title: Conquest Dark
description: Experience an ARPG's rapid ascension to power in minutes, packed with savage, survivors-like action and devastating sword & sorcery combat. Perfect your builds through Dark Ritual runs that will decide humanity's future as you battle endless hordes across haunting ruins and cursed kingdoms.

title: Vextorial
description: Vextorial is a mind-bending puzzle-platformer where you swap between 2D and 3D perspectives and twist gravity itself to solve impossible puzzles, explore a surreal, ancient ruin suspended in shifting dimensions, and uncover a mystery only you can piece together.

title: Kill The Music
description: Auto-Attack to the Beat of the Music and Hit Rhythm Inputs to boost your Damage! Build up your Solo Meter to trigger beautiful animations and cascading effects to mow down hordes of enemies!

title: Garten of Banban 0
description: Explore the origins of the mysterious Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the dark past of the establishment. Try to make some friends. Uncover the truth behind the place, and who you are

title: Vile: Exhumed
description: A game about misogynistic entitlement. Browse an old computer's files to uncover information about adult film actress Candy Corpse, and her recent departure from the industry.

title: Long Drive North
description: Explore and survive the harsh American wilderness in the Long Drive North. Drive and repair your trusty old RV, scavenge for parts, hunt and cook to survive; all alone or with up to 4 players in co-op. No zombies or monsters await – just an immersive driving-exploration-survival experience.

title: Tomb Raider: The Last Revelation
description:
A remaster of the original Tomb Raider IV: The Last Revelation, including The Times Exclusive Playable Level as well as the ability to toggle between original and remastered graphics.

Lara Croft discovers the lost tomb of the Egyptian God Set, unwittingly unleashing him and fulfilling an ancient prophecy—one that plunges mankind into darkness.

title: Blood of Mehran
description: In Blood of Mehran, explore sweeping sand dunes, bustling bazaars and sprawling palaces. Go blade to blade with enemies, pick them off from a distance with your arrows, or slip by them like a ghost. Level up and build your legend.

title: Inkshade
description: Inkshade is a turn-based tactics game carved out of strange wooden miniatures, wrapped in a web of locked rooms, and orchestrated by an otherworldly game master. Victory is not guaranteed, and the only constant is the cruel black ink that flows within the pieces.

title: Netherworld Covenant
description: In the abyss where the mortal realm and netherworld intertwine, becoming a warrior wielding the power of the Ethereal Torch to fight along with the fallen souls. With hardcore action and intriguing roguelike builds, shatter the cursed barriers and unveil the truth woven from blood and soul.

title: Cladun X3
description:
The third numbered entry in the Cladun series.

Cladun X3 is a highly customizable and dynamic pixel art action RPG with a focus on hack-and-slash gameplay. Utilize a variety of weapons, magic, and actions to fend off the monsters monsters and traps that await you, and clear the dungeons!

title: Inayah: Life after Gods
description: INAYAH - Life After Gods is a thrilling action-platformer with metroidvania elements. Immerse yourself in a story with multiple choices, explore diverse biomes, face more than 20 bosses, and develop your character with a unique progression system.

title: Gold Gold Adventure Gold
description: In this world, it’s all about the gold! Use it to build up a fantasy town, recruit heroes, give quests, raise a Godbeast, cast powerful spells, and expand your influence—all one gold coin at a time.

title: Runeborn
description: Runeborn is a dark fantasy roguelike that merges deckbuilding with a slot-machine-like mechanic. Forge your runebook, crush enemies, and combine trinkets of boundless power to destroy the forces of Despair!

title: Tokimeki Memorial: Forever with You - Emotional
Sea of Stars: Throes of the Watchmaker
description: This Sea of Stars DLC finds the Solstice Warriors Valere and Zale venturing into the miniature clockwork world of Horloge. In this magical land where denizens are threatened by a cursed carnival, our heroes will need to adapt to unfamiliar rules if their Sun and Moon powers are to manifest.

title: Jammer Dash
description: Jammer Dash is a 2D rhythm game in which you move and destroy objects on beat made for Windows and Linux! Inspired by many awesome games such as Muse Dash, Geometry Dash and osu!. Made in Unity and C#.

title: Lost Ember: Rekindled Edition
description:
The remastered edition of the acclaimed adventure features 4k, HDR, and overall improved graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5. Apart from the visual improvements, it includes a brand-new Free Roam mode with a new open world spreading over several biomes that includes all playable animals and new mini-challenges!

Owners of the original game will be able to upgrade for a small upgrade fee!

A breathtakingly beautiful world holds the secrets of its past for you and your companion to uncover in this 5-hour journey.

title: Wilmot Works It Out
description: Wilmot Works It Out is a puzzle building game about completing beautiful images and using them to decorate the walls of your house.

title: Deadly Days: Roadtrip
description:
Deadly Days: Roadtrip is an exciting action roguelite, that combines reverse bullet hell gameplay with strategic inventory management.

Start your road trip through the zombie apocalypse! Fight your way through, gain experience and collect items to assemble an epic inventory.

Craft more effective weapons and find out what items you can combine to withstand the ever-increasing waves of zombies.

title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie Demastered
description: Experience and play through the Super Mario Bros Movie in an all new epic way through an action packed retro 2D Platformer with over 80 levels, 6 playable characters, 90 Missions, Multiplayer and a rewritten story!

title: Heartspell: Horizon Academy
description: Match gems, level up, and date wizards in this match-3 visual novel with a lot of heart and a little spice. Form deep relationships with faeries, sirens and werewolves, each with their own endearing personalities and challenges. Make choices that affect your relationships, and their destinies.

title: Nekopara After
description: A new chapter begins with the arrival of the catgirl, Fraise! She seeks advice from his little sister, Shigure and while Fraise feels the relationship between siblings is most important, Shigure priorities the happiness of her catgirls. This sets the stage in the battle between catgirl and girl!

title: Beatblock
description: Spin to win, and move your paddle around to hit blocks to the beat. The song revolves around you, and it's your job to keep up.

title: Swapmeat
description: Frenetic roguelite meat 'em up action! Rip through alien worlds solo or co-op, harvest mutant body parts to wield their powers, and fulfill your delicious destiny.

title: BrokenLore: Low
description: Low, a first-person Horror Game, immerses players in the dark prelude of BrokenLore's story. Set in a mist-shrouded Japanese village, players uncover deep-seated hatred and ancient secrets. Navigate a hyperrealistic, claustrophobic environment where supernatural forces and tragic cycles abound.

title: Velev
description: Dive into VELEV's depths, a hidden world where technology and nature merge. Embark on quests, battle monsters, and unveil mysteries with enhanced gear. Experience intense PvPvE combat, strategic team play across diverse classes, and continuous character growth through exploration and extraction

title: Master of Command
description: Take command in Europe's greatest 18th-century war. Equip & customize regiments, manage supplies, and engage in brutal real-time battles across procedural campaigns. Resources and replacements are scarce, and keeping your best men alive may matter more than any single victory.

title: Rain World: The Watcher
description: Rain World: The Watcher is an expansion of Rain World. Journey beyond to something, somewhere only ever glimpsed. When the world beneath your feet cracks and crumbles, will you hold on to all you once new? Or dive into the unknown?

title: Darkest Dungeon II: Kingdoms
description: Kingdoms is a free standalone campaign game mode coming to Darkest Dungeon II. This new game mode challenges players in a desperate race against the clock to find and defeat a monstrous threat before it overwhelms and destroys the Kingdom. Journey across the land to gather resources and battle evil incursions, all while defending a network of safe haven Inns.

title: Cold VR
description: COLD VR It's the non-stop VR experience. With its twisting mechanics, this game will turn you into an unstoppable machine as you adapt and overcome challenges in each level, you are in control of time. Every time you stop, time flows; you move, it slows down. So, keep on moving!

title: Vindefiant
description: A disgruntled employee is fired from his job, sparking a path of rage and destruction. Lead Alyx through his journey of vengeance and creatively kill enemies in this pixel-art adventure where you, are the villain.

title: Somber Echoes
description: Take the role of the resurrected Adrestia and embark on an epic journey to prevent your twin sister from unraveling the universe. Master acrobatic combat, explore the Greco-Roman space vessel Atromitos, and shape your destiny in Somber Echoes.

title: Holy Shoot
description: In Holy Shoot, the player embarks on a journey as a member of The Sanctum. The ultimate goal is to defeat the powerful demons that represent the Seven Deadly Sins. Each character, is granted unique abilities and traits that make them valuable assets in the fight against demonic forces.

title: Phantom Squad
description: As a team of 2-4 players, communicate, plan, execute and improvise to succeed in this online coop, fast-paced, brutal top-down shooter where tactics are as crucial as skill.

title: Drive Beyond Horizons
description: Rev up your engines and venture into the unknown with Drive Beyond Horizons! Conquer dynamic landscapes, customize your ride, and unearth hidden treasures. Get ready for heart-pounding challenges and endless excitement. Your adventure starts now !

title: Swordhaven: Iron Conspiracy
description: Swordhaven is a classic party-based RPG. Explore the land of Nova Drakonia, embark on quests unique to your character, discover mysterious artefacts of the ancients, and unravel a hidden conspiracy that threatens the very existence of the world.

title: 9 Kings
description: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

title: Zombie Army VR
description: Zombie Hitler may have been defeated, but the zombie hordes are still at large and Europe remains in the throes of war. Return to the field as part of the Deadhunters, an elite squad fighting to end the zombie apocalypse!

title: Sol Cesto
description: Sol Cesto is a tactical and frenetic roguelite in which you have to master your luck. Choose a hero and reach the bottom of a random dungeon. In this grim world, every action has consequences...

title: Parallel Experiment
description: Dive into the secrets of the Parallel Experiment in this 2-player co-op puzzle game. Join forces as two detectives to finally catch the infamous Cryptic Killer. And remember - communication is key!

title: DC: Dark Legion
description: DC: Dark Legion is an action RPG set in the DC universe where players assemble teams of heroes and villains to battle threats. Fast-paced touchscreen combat combines character-specific abilities, gear progression, and PvE story missions with timed events and multiplayer arenas. Stylized graphics, collectible roster, and frequent updates for new characters and challenges.

title: Guntouchables
description: Guntouchables is a 1-4 player co-op survivor-like shooter. The world has fallen and is overrun by an endless horde of ever-evolving mutants. You and your ragtag group of gun runners must find and deliver crates of classified military supplies before the enemy can take advantage of their content.

title: Urban Jungle
description: Turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your tiny apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet the cat!

title: Nova Hearts
description: A mysterious force of power transforms you and other highly attractive people in your area into superheroes and villains! TEXT, DATE and FIGHT your friends and enemies alike.

title: Wizdom Academy
description: Build and manage your wizard academy as the headmaster. Feel the city-building thrill of constructing your magic school. Recruit students, guide them to become wizards, control resources, customize your castle, and expand your academy's influence and prestige. Start your legacy today!

title: Super Reaktor
description: Super reaKtor is a fast-paced Bullet Hell with original controls, where you must survive by collecting green energy pellets, and avoid or absorb various types of hostile TRI-SKL bullets.

title: Kaiserpunk
description: Build and conquer in Kaiserpunk, the ultimate city builder and grand strategy combo set in an alternative 20th century world. Engage in epic battles on land, sea, and air, or use your economic power to emerge as the ultimate victor.

title: Mindlock: The Apartment
description: Colin’s apartment maze has puzzles, dialogues, and some dry humor waiting for you. A surreal adventure of a special kind.

title: Over Requiemz
description:
“Whatever pain awaits, I won’t regret this choice.”

A dark fantasy game about overcoming grief as you wander into the “Land of Oz.”

title: Repose
description: Repose is an dark exploration/puzzle game. In Repose, explore, fight, and maintain a healthy sleep schedule as you descend the twisted levels of the corporation that hired you for unknown reasons.

title: Texnoplazm
description: Gun fu action centered on three intertwined movesets for punches, ranged weapons and firearms. Fight your enemies through the gothic metropolis while using their weapons against them, in the most acrobatic way possible.

title: Stray Path
description: Stray Path is an adventure and strategy game combining FreeCell and roguelike card. There are different characters and venturing in a randomly generated world. Dragging cards like FreeCell, optimizing choices, selecting equipment & items, discovering the truth of a stray world!

title: Stray Children
description: “The Olders, they come to eat the Children…” All of the adults have become monsters, the rumors say. Nowhere is safe outside these walls. Welcome to Stray Children — a bittersweet, fairy tale RPG, created by many of the same people behind beloved cult-classics like Chulip, Little King’s Story, Rule of Rose, Super Mario RPG, and, of course, Moon: Remix RPG Adventure.

title: Projected Dreams
description: Drag toys from the shelves and drop them on the table to create a shadow play in this cozy puzzle game. As the shadows unfold, immerse yourself in a heartwarming story full of nostalgia from the 90s and blur the lines between fantasy and reality.

title: Detective Dotson
description: Chase down criminals, spy on bad guys and solve cases! Change into a disguise or recruit a team member - your choices matter! Enjoy multi-genre gameplay and watch thrilling episodes. Games and stories from the endlessly intriguing modern day India!

title: Era One
description: Era One is an innovative space game that combines elements of real-time strategy, base building, space survival, and tactical battles. Players can create and customize their bases from scratch, construct various types of structures and warships, manage fleets, and engage in tactical space battles.

title: Let Them Come: Onslaught
description: Survive the relentless offensive of the alien horde in Let Them Come: Onslaught, a sci-fi survival roguelite. The pursuit of the perfect build and an ever-expanding arsenal of abilities are the keys to your success.

title: Tomba! Special Edition
description:
Our favourite pink-haired, high-jumping jungle boy is back!

Limited Run Games are working with creator Tokuro Fujiwara to bring the beloved platformer Tomba to modern consoles via the Carbon Engine, with a new soundtrack by the legendary FUJITA HARUMI.

title: Aftershock: Coastline
description: Aftershock: Coastline is a thrilling retro-styled survival horror shooter inspired by the design of Resident Evil and the atmosphere of Bioshock. Spend an hour delving deep into a seaside bunker in an uncanny land, uncovering its secrets and surviving against the cosmic horrors which dwell within.

title: Fretless: The Wrath of Riffson
description: In this turned-based RPG, wield powerful legendary instruments, gather mighty riff attacks and save the land from Rick Riffson's devilish goons and musical hybrid monsters!

title: Cipher Zero
description: A minimalist logic game. Can you solve for 𝒙?

title: Parcel Simulator
description: Inspect and dissect parcels and packages in this parcel inspection simulator! Examine labels for mistakes, contents for contraband and hone your parcel reviewing skills. Build, upgrade and expand your warehouse to take your parcel inspections to the next level!

title: Mark of the Deep
description: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate-themed adventure with strong narrative and a thrilling mix of Metroidvania and Souls-Like elements. Embark on this journey as the fierce Marcus "Rookie" Ramsey and explore the mysteries of a cursed island to find your missing pirate crew.

title: Flick Shot Rogues
description: Flick Shot Rogues is a turn-based rogue-lite that turns movement into a skill shot! Aim and flick your hero to ricochet through levels, dodge enemy attacks, and smash your foes with crazy trick shots. Featuring near-endless replayability, fun upgrades, and a ton of mayhem.

title: Supraworld
description: Supraworld is a first-person puzzle metroidvania. Be tiny in a handcrafted toy world. Explore, solve puzzles, ignore the main quest, get out of bounds, find secret areas, convict murderers. Hunt for powerful new abilities to unravel this vast, interconnected world… And don't forget to save the princess.

title: CraftCraft: Fantasy Merchant Simulator
description: CraftCraft is an RPG merchant sim with actual. Crafting. Create a tiara for a mermaid princess or a sword made of dragon blood - you choose! Express your creativity in your very own cozy crafting studio and change the lives of quirky locals in the mysterious port town of Windspell.

title: Camper Van: Make it Home
description: Decorate and organize the camper van of your dreams! Embark on a journey of self-discovery as you build your own home-on-wheels, using a combination of creative block organization puzzles and relaxing interior design. Make your heart feel at ease and your camper van feel like home.

title: Dawnfolk
description: Minimalist and relaxing survival builder perfect for short gaming sessions. Rebuild and manage your realm, collect resources and decide the fate of your people. Explore the darkness and unveil the secrets of the black monoliths to bring back light to the world.

title: PlayM2M
description:
In PlayM2M, an open-world fantasy online role-playing game, players can choose from four character classes: Dorhan, Skogr, Petrun, and Wizard. Each class has two specializations that offer distinct combat styles for Player vs. Environment (PvE) and Player vs. Player (PvP) modes.

PlayM2M focuses on real-time combat, crafting, exploration, and PvE and PvP content. Currently available in 11 languages, PlayM2M continues to grow with new content and plans for future international expansion.

title: A Corgi's Cozy Hike
description: Em-bark on a therapeutic adventure as a Corgi exploring a peaceful island getaway. Climb the mountain, soar the sky, and sail the seas to uncover treasures and cozy spots. No need to rush. Relax and savor this bite-sized, open-world experience while 10% of your purchase is donated to animal shelters.

title: StarVaders
description: Defend the Earth from an alien invasion in the ULTIMATE fusion of deckbuilding and grid-based tactics. Pilot a mech, discover game-breaking combos, and protect the future of humanity in this endlessly replayable roguelike.

title: Darkenstein 3D
description: A retro shooter inspired by the older Wolfenstein and Doom games. A tribute of sorts, if you like, where I aspire emulate the games I love the most and that requires a certain amount of skill to complete, while adding a few personal and more current-day touches.

title: Dawn Apart
description: Mine resources, maintain a growing settlement of fortune hunters and defend it against the fierce native population. Or flip the script - and start a rebellion against the greedy corporation exploiting your new home…

title: Haste
description: Haste is a fast-paced running game where you race to reach the portal at the end of a collapsing universe. Run through an infinite amount of levels where no world is ever the same. Between each attempt to complete your run you have the chance to explore a hub world, gather your strength, meet characters and practice your skills before heading out for another adventure. Each run has its own unique challenges with clues to figure out why the worlds are breaking apart.

title: CarX Street
description: Get behind the wheel and explore the large city and its surroundings, from busy city streets to spiral mountain roads and mesmerizing coastal highways. Drift, speed, traffic; be the best & challenge other players in real network races.

title: Into Evil
description: In this modernized take on old-school roguelikes! Explore a vast megadungeon where death lurks around every corner! Battle nightmarish foes in frenetic real time combat! Brand yourself with the souls of fallen heroes!

title: Ars Notoria
description: Explore the fantasy world of Ars Notoria, a survival-action RPG set inside an open-world sandbox that lets you hunt powerful possessed creatures. Strike out on your own or play together with friends to build a sprawling faction, utilizing deep crafting mechanics and strategic recruiting of allies.

title: Synergy
description: Humans live on a hostile planet. In this survival city-building game, develop your city, face natural disasters, make the right choices. Explore this environment-changing world while keeping your people happy despite extreme weather conditions.

title: Psychroma
description: Psychroma is a narrative-driven side-scroller where you play as a digital medium. Confront the past by piecing together the broken memories of a cybernetic house, and exorcise the ghosts in the machine.

title: So to Speak
description: Can you learn a language by solving puzzles? So to Speak is a simulation game about wandering around Japan, looking at signs, overhearing conversations, and using context clues in the environment to figure out what it all means. No background in Japanese is assumed.

title: Star Salvager
description:
A neo retro / roguelike / action-puzzler

Salvage your way through a sea of space junk and take on the alien horde with the ultimate custom-fitted fighting drone!

Cabinet-style arcade combat mixed with fast-paced combo-making.

title: Gaucho and the Grassland
description: Gaucho and the Grassland is an Animal Farm Sim game where you need to gather resources, explore the land, breed animals and much more, to overcome the challenging life on the grasslands. The world of Gaucho is a mystical wildland, inspired by South Brazil's culture and its local tales.

title: Cat Detective Albert Wilde
description: Cat Detective Albert Wilde is a comedy game, a genre-bending noirish sci-fi mystery set in a fictional version of New York in the 1930's featuring atmospheric black & white vintage visuals, and loveable anthropomorphic characters. Players must muddle their way through a murder mystery that's messier than a fresh hairball, with a captivating voice-over and at least one joke about cat nipples (they have six!).

title: The Silent Kingdom
description: The dark tale of a princess who must corrupt her own soul in order to save her kingdom, reaping death and sorrow along the path.

title: I Just Want to Be Single!!
description: I Just Want To Be Single!! is a visual novel dating simulation game where the twist is that you do not want to date the cast of eligible bachelorettes. In the game, you play as Aya, a socially awkward girl in her second year of high school, who only wants to make friends. Unfortunately, being a new transfer student starts turning heads and gets the attention of everyone in her class.

title: Tyrant's Realm
description: Tyrant's Realm is a challenging action roguelike. Fill your arsenal with weapons and armor each with their unique gameplay mechanics. Tread carefully in this dark fantasy world because every enemy you face could be your end.

title: Campus Life
description: In Campus Life you’ll create your own college freshman. Experience the hardships of college in this amusing and engaging life sim game. Study hard and party even harder. Join a fraternity to meet new interesting individuals. It is entirely up to you how your academic career will progress!

title: Sandwalkers
description: Sandwalkers is a roguelike turn-based exploration game. Build your team, traverse varied hostile environments, face countless dangers, and gain knowledge that will help you find and resurrect the Mother Tree Umama.

title: RoboCop: Rogue City
description: RoboCop: Rogue City is a first-person shooter set in the dystopian world of Old Detroit. Players step into the role of RoboCop, enforcing the law with a mix of brutal combat, investigation, and decision-making. Featuring a story set between RoboCop 2 and 3, the game combines cinematic action, cyberpunk atmosphere, and moral choices.

title: Celestial Empire
description: The Emperor has chosen you as a new provincial governor. Design the city of your dreams, admiring its details from a bird's-eye view. Take care of your people, develop efficient production chains and trade with other landlords. Ensure their survival through harsh winters and disasters.

title: Spirit Swap: Lofi Beats to Match-3 To
description: Spirit Swap: Lofi Beats to Match-3 To is an action-puzzle game set in a lush, narrative-driven world of witchy demons. Cast spells, be queer, & crash the biggest concert of the year!

title: Peripeteia
