Inspect documents, question passengers, scan luggage, and seize illegal goods as you try to maintain control at Caldora Airport. Will you uphold the law or profit from contraband?

title: Tormentum II
description: Tormentum II is a standalone dark point-and-click adventure in which a man wakes imprisoned inside a nightmarish simulation he created. Set in a surreal world rendered in roughly 500 hand-drawn images inspired by H. R. Giger and Zdzisław Beksiński, the game blends dark fantasy with unsettling questions about consciousness and control. Players explore the island prison, solve puzzles, and make morally ambiguous choices that shape the fates of the game's inhabitants and lead to multiple endings.

title: Orwell: Keeping an Eye on You
description: Using the new governmental security program that has the power to survey the online presence of every person in The Nation, you investigate the lives of citizens to find those responsible for a series of terror attacks. Information from the internet, personal communications and private files are all accessible to you. But, be warned, the information you supply will have consequences…

title: Subspace Brawl
description: Subspace Brawl is a top-down space battle that a streamer's Twitch chat plays. Viewers type !join to get a ship that flies and fights on its own in the streamer's arena, then steer the fight from chat: firing missiles and mines, raising shields, ramming and retreating to their base. Cheers call orbital strikes on random ships and channel point redeems drop nukes, black holes and other calamities. Modes include team Factions, Free-For-All and Boss fights where the whole chat teams up against a giant boss, with time or stock (lives) win conditions, results boards and seasonal cosmetics. Free to play on Windows or in the browser.

title: The Conjuring: Unspoken
description:
The Conjuring: Unspoken, a new Netflix game, is coming October 13.

Set in a decaying English pub where a family is haunted by an ancient evil, use your phone as a paranormal investigation tool and make life-or-death choices that shape your story.

Developed by Supermassive Games.

title: The Hollowing
description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

title: Scam With Your Friends
description: Run a scam call center with your friends. Use increasingly ridiculous schemes to trick AI callers out of their life savings. Hit your daily quota, cause chaos around the office, and survive a brutal performance review from your rageaholic boss.

title: Thank You Bus Driver
description: Thank You Bus Driver is a chaotic bus driving game where you take on the role of a town’s bus driver just trying to get through the day with minimal rulebreaking and maximum gratitude… in the form of Thank Yous!

title: Dino Crisis 2
description: A port of Dino Crisis 2 originally released on the PlayStation, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

title: Find The Needle
description: Your a pleasant farmer that dropped a bag of needles into a haystack, now your goal is to find the needle. Incremental game where you build multiple Satisfactory style structures and create real production lines to construct the biggest hay processing and needle finding factory possible.

title: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
description: Just in time for the 20th anniversary, You Are Empty has been revitalized for modern systems, with fixes, new features, and QoL additions, including all the official localizations. Our team carefully went through the entire game whilst faithfully preserving the intent of the original release.

title: Company Tycoon
description: A cyberpunk-styled business simulation and tycoon game where players build, scale, and manage their own tech empire.

title: Godreaper
description: Godreaper is a dark third-person action-adventure where the fate of your homeland hangs in the balance. As the bogatyr Zaremire, explore every corner of a world inspired by East Slavic mythology. Defeat the creatures of Navi, battle almighty gods and save your homeland from inevitable destruction.

title: FreshWomen: Season 3
description: FreshWomen is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the best parts of life. You're a college freshman who just earned a mansion. Bring girls to your home to romance, date, or fuck them. Your journey will be filled with comedy, love, and lots of sex.

title: Rehaunted
description: Enter a house where every clue feels wrong. Investigate a brutal crime scene, uncover hidden evidence, and use your detective tools to piece together a disturbing truth buried beneath the silence.

title: Grizzy & the Lemmings: Crazy Party
description: Turn your living room into a chaotic playground! 50 mini-games, 1-4 players on the couch, one goal: grab the Yummy before your friends, while Grizzy does everything to ruin it.

title: Paper Shredder
description: Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath.

title: Stream Bakery
description: A cozy multiplayer game built for Twitch streamers and their communities. Complete orders, earn rewards, and work together to run a bustling bakery!

title: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen
description: This is a bundle containing both Dragon's Dogma II and the Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion.

title: Salvation: Echoes of War
description: Explore a haunting purgatory in this third-person stealth adventure. Injured and trapped in a nightmare after war, solve puzzles, outsmart enemies, and rely on your loyal companion to find a way back to life. Can you escape your past and survive the echoes of war?

title: Pop! Pachinko
description: Pop! Pachinko is a pachinko roguelite with city pop vibes. Build up your collection of enchanted balls to fire into the machine. Collect charms to build up powerful synergies between your balls. Listen to some pop music as you expand your Chibi Pop collection!

title: Bubbly
description: Fast-paced roguelike extraction arcade game. Pop endless waves of bubbles, build devastating upgrade combinations, defeat powerful bosses, and decide when to extract before losing everything.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Dark Heresy
description: Become an acolyte of the Inquisition in this grim dark, party-based, story-driven cRPG. Lead investigations, uncover grand conspiracies, master tactical combat, and wage a secret war against heresy. Make tough choices as a conduit of the God-Emperor’s will.

title: Liminal Point
description: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

title: Light Odyssey
description: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

title: Zwaard
description: Explore a world where you try to preserve the still existing life forms. Technology has taken over and will try it's best to stop you in your adventure. Whilst those technologies try to stop you they could also be the only reason you're still alive.

title: Hark the Ghoul
description: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! Hark the Ghoul offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

title: AGX GP
description: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

title: Gummy Nightmares
description: Step into the enigmatic world of Gummy Nightmares as a little boy who wakes up in a mysterious amusement park with no memory. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover lost memories while evading sinister plushie robots. Use weapons, set traps, and find hideouts to survive and reveal the truth

title: Deperson
description: Are you ready to step into a dark and mysterious world with Aaron, who is afraid of his own shadow? A file that has been closed for years is opened again, the forgotten ones wake up from their sleep and the silence is broken by screams.

title: Guns 'n Goblins
description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

title: Frieda is Changing
description: Frieda’s fourteen, furious, and sick of secrets. Uncover the real reason for your sister’s disappearance: Snoop through an isolated village, crack puzzles and stir up trouble. But hurry - monsters are lurking where you least expect them.

title: Portabellows
description: Explore a whimsical island to find… pie recipes?! Bake them by gathering or growing ingredients, which may be the key to helping out your new found quirky friends leave the island! In this wholesome 3D platformer collectathon, you can enjoy discovering the world freely at your own pace.

title: Fragile Existence
description: Take command of the last surviving fleet of humankind in Fragile Existence, a sci-fi RTS with fully 3D planet surfaces and vast solar systems to explore. Dispatch expeditions to find resources, build settlements, construct vital parts and supplies, and evolve your technology to meet new threats.

title: Starfinder: Afterlight
description:
The first party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well — save the galaxy while you're at it!

In Starfinder: Afterlight, you will assemble a crew of misfits from across the Pact Worlds and become the legends in this single player party-based RPG: find unique companions scattered across the stars, each with their personal stories and dilemmas.

There are no wrong answers: experience a story-driven game where choices matter and nothing is forbidden - everything has consequences. Factions remember your deeds and companions judge your heart in a game with branching storylines which ensure no two adventures are alike.

title: Trainwatch
description: Meet Troy, the new Gatekeeper. His job is simple - close the gates at a desolate railway crossing for one month. This is his last chance to earn back his wife's trust. To prove he can stay sober. To become a better man. Join him at the Tower in the middle of nowhere. Help Troy fix his life.

title: Humblets
description: Humblets is a cozy adventure for 1-4 players where you explore a charming procedural world. Pack your tent and embark on a journey as you craft, decorate, befriend magical creatures and solve challenges with the magic of cards. No pressure, just peaceful exploration and fireside stories!

title: Nonolith
description: Discover the countless secrets of the NONOLITH. Copy and paste blocks to reach new areas, and master hidden mechanics that let you do the seemingly impossible. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

title: Winds of Viridia
description: Explore the valley of the towering Grantree, battle grand beasts, and find out what’s driving the creatures in these forgotten lands mad. Discover secrets, make new friends, and find powerful lost relics. Take on fearsome bosses, and uncover the truth of the wild frenzy.

title: Infamous Keepers
description: Defend your dungeon AND your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

title: Kitaria Fables 2
description: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend!

title: False Echo
description: Inspired by Papers, Please, False Echo is a narrative cryptography thriller set in the darkest depths of the Atlantic, aboard a secret military submarine. Operate the Obscura machine, decode messages, and decide what gets through in a regime where even the smallest mistake means a huge death toll.

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

title: Flesh & Wire
description: Flesh & Wire is a first-person shooter that delves into the psychological horror roots of the POSTAL series. Venture into this twisted reality as Angel, a hapless victim suddenly swept up in a fever dream of conspiracy and blood as she seeks answers and vengeance against the crazed gunman who changed her life forever.

title: Beware of the Cartographer!
description:
A young cartographer is sent out by his hierarchy into the rural land of his childhood to redraw a frontier: he will gradually discover that this place, which for him was just a set of inky territories, is actually steeped in stories, inhabited by people who have no idea what's going on around them and whose relationship to space is radically different...
The player embodies a land surveyor who explores a rural territory and must make choices that will have an impact on diplomacy, but also on the local population. The game combines visual novel phases and observational puzzles — the two aspects nourishing each other to modify the plot of an interactive story.

title: The Granny Detective Society
description: A cozy and quirky detective game where Madeline, a retired little mouse, watches her street and dives into thrilling investigations… until the Granny Detective Society contacts her and she discovers that the whole neighborhood is living a double life… especially the grannies.

title: Gachiakuta: Breakout
description: Based on the hit TV anime, GACHIAKUTA: BREAKOUT is a survival action RPG featuring intense melee combat and fast-paced battles. Build your team and master dynamic mechanics to defeat powerful foes. Explore the world of Gachiakuta in striking cartoon-style visuals.

title: A Date with Death 2: Remnants
description: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

title: Begraved
description: A cosy & dark first-person co-op dungeon crawler where you loot cursed crypts, dodge traps, and flee from things that should not move. Escape with treasures snatched from the dead. Decorate your hideout, uncover buried secrets, and remember: the Taxman always comes for his due.

title: The Vow: Vampire's Curse
description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder fused with turn-based tactics. Build your deck, master deadly synergies, and survive seven cursed nights to rescue your fiancée from the vampire’s grasp.

title: Living Hell
description: A co-op horror where you must retrieve specimens before sunrise, as solar radiation twists animals and humans into terrifying mutations.

title: Appa
description: Appa is a narrative driven simultaneous card game about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. You play as Varun witnessing surreal nightmares and manifestations of his deceased father and playing a card game with him.

title: Rebounder
description: Rebounder is a precision platformer set in a four-ink, pulp-print world. Grab, throw, bounce through an off-world worksite with trick-shot ricochets and fast retries. May induce speedrunning mania.

title: Lollipop Chainsaw 2 Back2Back
description: Juliet returns to a rebuilt San Romero, now transformed into “Jaredwood”, a sprawling metropolis built around the film industry. When a mysterious director traps her inside his twisted zombie movie, Juliet must fight alongside her allies, uncover the conspiracy behind the chaos, and stop a new threat posed by the Corrupted Realm zombies.

title: Among the Waves
description: Among the Waves is a science fiction metroidvania with platforming elements. Explore the dark corridors of the Alatyr-M fortress, diving into mysteries of religion and ancient technology. Manipulate physics with unique abilities, uncover hidden pathways, battle enemies and challenging bosses.

title: Stardream
description: Stardream is a story-driven investigation game set in a retro 60s-inspired space ark. As Darlene, a taxi driver turned into a reluctant investigator, uncover a hidden truth that could shatter a perfect society.

title: Mushroom Hunter Simulator
description: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

title: Stars of Icarus
description: Assemble your crew and take to the stars in a team-based PvP dogfight. Enter the forgotten arenas of space, master your ship's loadout and strategize with the rest of your ragtag squadron. Victory or death, together.

title: Robot Rhapsody
description: A futurist fairytale exploring AI themes, technology, existentialism, and strange transformations in a suffering world. A retro-inspired JRPG presentation of a modernist, character-driven drama.

title: Sagas of Lumin
description: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

title: Aokaki
description: Aokaki is a fast-paced 2D platformer where you play as an isopod ronin. Explore fun and challenging levels while battling against the forces of the evil Shogun in this bug inhabited pixelart world.

title: Shadows of Chroma Tower
description: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

title: Graytail
description: Graytail is a Zelda-like action-adventure game with interactive puzzles and combat set on a small island in the Pacific. Find the missing best female pilot and uncover the secrets hidden on the island.

title: Gunmetal Gothic
description: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic. Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

title: Forge of the Fae
description: Explore a story-rich, mysterious world inspired by Celtic folklore, use crystals to channel powerful magic, and make impactful choices that change the story's outcome. A unique Crystal System and battles with dangerous Fae await in this charming, pixel-style, retro modern RPG.

title: Kloa: Child of the Forest
description: Consumed by a mysterious curse, restore a once lush forest and its inhabitants to their natural state in this action adventure tale. Experience fast-paced combat, puzzles, and the beauty of nature captured in handcrafted pixel art.

title: Vice Undercover
description: Vice Undercover is a 1980's narco thriller where the only way to stop the deadly cartel is from within. Go undercover. Expose the cartel. Hack the drug war.

title: Shell Soldier
description: Shell Soldier is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

title: Mars Tactics
description: Classic turn-based tactical combat with some modern twists. Use stress to manage RNG. Master advanced suppression mechanics. Grow troops who develop abilities, personalities & relationships based on what happens in battle. Procedural, destructible maps. Realistic bullet physics.

title: Being & Becoming
description: Being & Becoming is a dark, atmospheric metroidvania set in a kingdom consumed by a Collective Dream. Play as a Lucid Dreamer, able to possess the corrupted, absorb their spirits, and wield them as weapons to break the world free from its endless slumber.

title: Rune Fencer Illyia
description: Rune Fencer Illyia is an intense, atmospheric action-platformer with a heavy focus on exploration and combat. Traverse an enormous and dangerous world, meet strange allies, and outfight your numerous foes with fast-paced swordplay and stolen runic magic.

title: Rustown
description: Five years after the idiot virus pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

title: The Escapists 3
description: Plan ridiculous prison breaks, outsmart the guards and escape your way in The Escapists 3. Craft, sneak, fight and improvise through a new 3D prison sandbox, alone or with friends. Just remember to make roll call.

title: Gods with Badges
description: Patrol the streets of Scarhelm. Decide the fate of your fellow citizens. Take down criminals in brutal turn-based combat. You are a god with a badge, and when you turn on your bodycam, the only thing you answer to is your conscience, and your fellow officers.

title: Jiaohun
description: Today is Dec 31, 1999. Happy New Year. And now, a message from Fairy Town's end...

title: Really Illegal Golf
description: Golf, but make it illegal. Defy your membership ban and wreak havoc with friends in co-op, or tee off for a high score. Evade security, defend yourself with a customizable arsenal and take your games to the most outrageous places. Who said a tower crane wasn't the perfect place for a hole-in-one?

title: Vaewolf
description: Half-werewolf, half-vampire… all vengeance. Unleash your relentless wrath in a brutal, ceaseless quest for revenge in a bold Hack and Slash power fantasy set in the untamed English North.

title: Black Walls
description: Explore a silent, impossible world of puzzles and obstacles. Make symbolic choices whose consequences may not be clear, your decisions shape your ending. Choose Chill Mode for a calm, mysterious journey with nothing hunting you, or Horror Mode for fear, danger, and something that wants you dead.

title: Matelotes
description: The Royal Hen has disappeared! Lead a group of enthusiastic (though unqualified) sailors on a quest for glory, riches, and, as fate would have it, poultry. Visit a variety of islands, resolve political conflicts, and upgrade your boat in this narrative adventure game inspired by RPGs.

title: Chosen By Odin
description: Hunt the cults of Ragnarök across epic Norse realms in this 1-3 player co-op action game. Wield Godly powers, roll dice to shape mighty builds with your friends, and escape as overwhelming hordes close in. Return to Valhalla, grow stronger, and rewrite the saga.

title: Terranigma
description: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

title: The Subminer
description: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

title: Elysium
description:
Elysium is a next-generation third-person mmorpg featuring a seamless open world, multiplayer gameplay, survival mechanics, crafting systems, AI companions, and player-driven progression; created by Mercenary Games, Elysium combines the best elements of mmorpgs, rpgs, open-world adventures, strategy games, and social multiplayer experiences into a living universe shaped by both players and artificial intelligence.
Explore vast lands, discover hidden secrets, build your legacy, participate in large-scale events, develop professions, engage in trade, battle powerful enemies, and influence the evolving world around you.

title: Cassette Beasts 2002
description: Jump back into the world of beasts in Cassette Beasts 2002, coming to Xbox Series S | X, PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC! A follow-up to the critically-acclaimed creature collector, Cassette Beasts, this new journey will have players fuse with over 240 beasts - any two beasts can be combined into over 50,000 combinations, all fully animated!

title: Headcutter
description: HEADCUTTER is a Sci-fi Spaghetti Western FPS with BRUTAL combat, DESTRUCTIBLE environments, and LOTS O'GORE. You're a space bounty hunter, track targets, explore destroyable maps with multiple routes with CRUNCHY gunplay and cut their heads to get your money. Come on now, go out and GET SOME HEADS!

title: Come To My Party!
description: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.

title: Iron Bramble
description: Momentum-based platforming built around expressive movement and tight gunplay. Master your elastic grappling hook to explore a vast, cyber-gothic megastructure, where robots piloted by the souls of the dead do penance for their sins.

title: Caravana 2000
description: Choose your almost-famous costume and face the dangers of Brazilian chaotic nights. In this action roguelike, survive hordes, farm aura, wield sinister gadgets, and create insane combinations while dancing in the face of danger.

title: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold
description: Prepare for Evercold, the sixth expansion pack in the ever‑expanding world of Final Fantasy XIV Online.

title: Totopia
description: Totopia is calling! Drip in your style and crush 100+ chaotic maps, or smash the Bitrot crisis with Atomon skills! Need a recharge? Visit Pulse Avenue to build, plant, or run a cozy cafe. Cast your fishline, chill, and vibe with quirky Atomons. Your world, your way—join the squad and catch that W!

title: Liquid Lungs
description: Liquid Lungs is a high-speed FPS blending fluid parkour with intense combat. Inspired by free-running action games and fast-paced shooters, it delivers a seamless mix of movement and marksmanship in a dystopian world. Run, jump, and fight in a nonstop adrenaline rush where every motion counts.

title: Lurking
description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

title: Intravenous 3
description: Tense stealth action, tactical hardcore gunplay, and missions & story shaped by the way you play. Step into the roles of Steve and Sean, outnumbered and forced to survive a relentless manhunt.

title: Midgardr
description: A board game where you play as a Duke sent to build and protect a village at the edge of the realm. Every choice you make will shape its future. But be aware: the board itself may not be all it seems... Will your village thrive or crumble beneath truths yet unknown? Are you really just... a Duke?

title: Whisk
description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

title: Imprinted
description: Looking for a forensic specialist to restore damaged audio tapes (late 1970s). Warning: The artist was involved in the occult; she disappeared under suspicious circumstances. The nature of the recordings may be distressing. Mental clarity and resilience are a must. QUOTE REQUESTED.

title: Westlanders
description: Forge your legacy in the Westlands. Survive and thrive in a Wild West open world. Alone or with friends, explore, fight, and build from your customizable wagon. Expand into bustling settlements, recruit allies, and forge a network to tame the wilderness and build your legacy.

title: Encryptid
description: Encryptid is a short FMV horror game about hunting and catching cryptids. Use real-world footage recorded exclusively via the Gameboy Camera to identify, locate and capture iconic creatures of myth and folklore.

title: The Darkside Detective: Backside of the Moon
description: You'd think that after 20+ cases, there'd be no crime left in Twin Lakes - but that's not how crime works, rookie. Six new mind-melting mysteries await Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley - just as soon as they get the mustard out of Dooley's gun.

title: Epoch Reset
description: Unravel a narrative-driven 2.5D anime adventure as Hector, a dirt-poor genius and creator of the world’s first time machine. Travel between timelines, meet intriguing characters, and explore futuristic cityscapes as you seek to save reality from time-bending forces beyond imagination.

title: End of Eden
description: End of Eden is an open world RPG where you arrive unwanted on a cursed island and must earn every inch. Master tight melee, archery and magic. Join a faction, grow deep talents, craft gear, and explore a living world with real routines, tough bosses and meaningful quests.

title: Abelina
description: Explore a surreal wilderness by platforming and use timing based hits to gather resources. Break open branching paths to get to the other side of a giant world, talk to it's strange inhabitants, and try to understand the nature of this world.

title: UvsU: You vs. You
description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

title: Contact Protocol
description:
Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator taking place in a gritty, cassette-future. Humanity has spread throughout the solar system and started extracting its natural resources.

You play as the security officer aboard PALE HORSE - a Galileo Corporation vessel carrying miners set for Ganymede, Jupiter's biggest moon. It’s your job to assess the intentions of approaching ships, decide their fate, and keep your crew alive. The company is watching.

title: Rescue Ops: Wildfire
description: Rescue Ops: Wildfire is an immersive and dynamic firefighter simulation game where you can battle unpredictable, dynamic mega-fires solo or in co-op, using ground and aerial vehicles, fire hose systems, tactical support and more.

title: Memoria Wake
description: Battle nightmares in the dream world as you unravel reflections of the past in Memoria Wake, an isometric souls-like action-adventure game.

title: Chunky Jump!
description: Chunky JUMP! is a short horror platformer where you must survive through the night on your BIRD BOY. But beware... the Ghabbit is hunting.

title: The Bagman
description: The bagman is an authentic retro 16-bit horror point and click/survival horror that layers in stealth, commandable NPCS, and gratuitous slasher gore! Time and events continually tick forward, and any of your friends can die. Many paths to follow, multiple endings. Will you survive?

title: Project; Virai: Doomer's Life Escape
description: Help a doomer girl make her VTuber persona popular and escape her depressive routine. If you can.

title: Dicewood
description:
Dicewood is a fantasy horror turn-based roguelike deck-builder where adorable forest animals band together to escape the relentless hunter.

Fleeing into a dark, twisted forest filled with ancient horrors, creepy monsters, and cannibal tribes, player must strategically combine different animals, overcome nightmarish foes, and make their way to the river to start a new life.

title: Voivod: The Nuclear Warrior
description: A run-and-gun metroidvania set in Voivod’s dystopian universe. Battle biomechanical mutants, explore a twisted post-apocalyptic world, and recover fragments of your lost mind. Featuring pixel-art visuals, tight action-platforming, and Voivod soundtrack.

title: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster
description: This game tells a story of heart-to-heart connections and salvation surrounding Mono, a girl who visits the medical facility “Ishokan” in hopes of saving her older sister, who has been afflicted by the terrifying “Shinigami Disease”; Melhendia, a goat-like creature who seeks to exploit her; and the girls who the disease have transformed into strange creatures.

title: Postal 2 VR
description: POSTAL 2 VR lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for VR. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona—buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of absurd weapons and unpredictable NPCs. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears
description:
"The past has a voice and its calling you home."

"You hoped you'd never have to return to this place of sorrow, but after 20 years, something has called you back."

Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears is a complete reimagining of Scott Cawthon's original *Five Nights at Freddy's* game. The game is directed by JDBRYANT and is created by Bloody Fungi, a passionate team of over 30 people.

title: City of None
description: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

title: Ballistic.exe
description: A despicably detailed shooting simulator wrapped in a declassified computer program. Dozens of weapons, 200+ cartridges, 1000+ attachments, and absolutely nothing supernatural.

title: Vampire Huntress: Lament of the Sun
description: Classic survival horror experience set in a dark gothic world. Play as Luna Ashcroft and explore an interconnected world filled with incomprehensible horrors, mind-bending puzzles and countless secrets. Are you ready to face the horrors of the night? LET THE HUNT BEGIN!

title: Omega Phenex Commenced Project Six
description: You will become a pilot of the mech “Icarus,” which has tremendous maneuverability. You will enjoy a fight and face large powerful armies and rivals by moving from skimming the surface of the sea to the cloud with Icarus. This game is a high-speed mech shooting game capable of firing massive amounts of missiles.

title: Tricky and the Dream Caster
description:
Tricky O'Possum has been hit with a sleep curse, trapping him in Caster's dream domain!
With the help of his new pal Volt, he's gotta collect the keys to Caster's Castle and beat him up to break the curse.
Utilize Tricky's expressive, free-form moveset to explore the various worlds of the Astral Plane, all inspired by the library of a certain ill-fated 6th gen console.

title: Everbloom
description: Everbloom is a cute and cozy farming social sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

title: Piggy One Super Spark
description: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

title: Mops & Mobs: A Sweeping Dungeon Adventure
description: Mops & Mobs is a humorous dungeon adventure, spicing up storytelling with decoration quests and card-based battles. Befriend eccentric monsters and solve problems as the dungeon’s janitor. Clean, decorate, investigate, and eventually uncover dangers threatening the dungeon.

title: Dark Lessons
description: Can you survive your teacher in this psychological horror game? With only candles for light and trapped in her home, you have to uncover her family's dark secrets. Solve puzzles, connect the dots and escape. But beware: There is someone else playing games with you, and someone who needs your help.

title: Tidebound
description: Tidebound is a fishing and inventory management game with a relaxing, casual atmosphere. Catch, sell, upgrade your boat, and sail further to catch more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

title: Undefeated: Genesis
description: The ultimate superhero experience. Fly freely and unleash your awesome powers as you battle violent mutants to save an alien planet.

title: Drill Keeper
description: Drill Keeper combines roguelite deckbuilding and tower defense into a strategic battle for survival. Dig through completely destructible worlds to strip them of their riches and build an impenetrable fortress of mining.

title: Beyond the Plastic Wall
description: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.

title: Sanctuary: Shattered Sun
description: Sanctuary is a Traditional Real Time Strategy game featuring Strategic Zoom, Streaming Economy, Simulated Projectiles and Grand Scale. Take control of armies of hundreds upon hundreds of units and crush your enemies!

title: Name of the Will
description: You are informed to be a resident of Hope, a suspiciously harmonious community. Dodge the secretive governors, establish a rapport with your neighbors who monitor you, and solve puzzles to find out how you got here. Are you willing to sacrifice for the truth? Or, are you choosing a life of oblivion?

title: Abyss Fantasia
description: The city "Cynthia" on the edge of the abyss, the "missing" girl who didn't know where she came from began to step into the abyss. Experience the complex emotional, mysterious biological environment under the Abyss. Finally face the deepest darkness of the abyss.

title: Taste of Heaven
description: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

title: High Elo Girls
description: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team. Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

title: Zaos
description:
Zaos is a free-to-play fantasy MMORPG. Instead of channels, players share one world. A shared capital serves everyone, crowded areas open copies of themselves automatically, and chat is translated live into each reader's language across nine supported languages. Bosses use tactical AI: they need line of sight for many attacks, path around obstacles, pick attacks by range, crowd size and health, and change phase mid-fight. Before a big attack they show a ground warning matching the real damage area. Players can also fly mounts over open maps.

Players choose one of four classes, each with two paths, and progress to level 90 through regions that act as story chapters. Along the way are dungeons with Easy, Medium and Hard difficulties and long-term systems such as Infusion, Ascension and the post-cap Constellation. There are also guilds with their own land, scheduled guild wars, a monthly Battle Pass, and PvP from a no-risk arena up to a lawless zone. Power items cost Wans, a currency earned by playing. The premium currency, Zens, buys only cosmetics and convenience.

title: Anima: Song from the Abyss
description: Song from the Abyss is the new Action RPG set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters and explore a world full of mysteries. Experience a fluid combat system and a deep story with unforgettable characters.

title: VR Sandbox
description: VR Sandbox is an immersive virtual reality physics-based sandbox game. The game focuses on absolute freedom of action, advanced object interaction, and experimentation within virtual environments. Players can manipulate physics, build structures, test mechanics, and experience tailored gameplay designed specifically for VR enthusiasts.

title: Waveling Island
description: Waveling Island is a Creature-Collecting Sim that takes place on a beautiful, hand-drawn pixelart island full of mysterious creatures called Wavelings. Catch, train and battle these creatures in order to complete quests, gather materials, and make a stake in this new tropical home of yours.

title: Afterzero: The Last Drive
description: Drive and survive through a frozen post-industrial wasteland. Gear up your vehicle with different tools to tackle hostile threats, while scavenging for resources. Lead a small survivor camp while discovering the truth about what happened.

title: My Penguin Friend
description: Washed up thousands of miles from home, Dindim, a little penguin on a big journey must puzzle across an unfamiliar, tropical coastline, and forge an unlikely friendship to find more than just his way home.

title: Sker: The Bleeding Veil
description: Evade Sister Gwenllian and her ritual-bound orphans as you use sound to explore, solve harmonic puzzles and survive blind stalkers that hunt by hearing. Sker: The Bleeding Veil is a first-person, stealth-focused survival horror set in the Sker universe.

title: Night at the Fun Park
description: A horror game set in an abandoned amusement park. Players search for exit keys while avoiding a giant spider, using noise to distract it and freeing captured teammates from cocoons.

title: Cursed Gas Station
description: At an isolated gas station in the 1990s, Cole takes a night-shift job that comes with a room to stay in. As you serve customers, unexplained events begin to unfold in this psychological horror game.

title: Toxic Frontier
description: Unlock powerful cards and build a safe haven for your people within a world in ruins. In this roguelike city-builder, deploy cards across a hex grid to expand your colony and purify the land, buying another day of survival in the noxious wastes.

title: Dust Till Dawn
description: A retro-paranormal powerwash simulator, where you're a maid restoring a quiet rural Japanese village. Dust, mop, squeegee to your heart's content...but don't stay too late!

title: Faraday Blues
description: Faraday Blues is a surreal science fiction adventure about a daughter searching for parents who don't know she exists. Play as Lina, a mysterious girl who awakens in a place she doesn't understand. An old computer introduces her to a strange game table filled with cards. Two of them bear the faces of her parents. However, they have no idea who she is. Worse still: their lives are already marked by tragedy.

title: Family Time
description: Build a family with thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

title: Ondeh Ondeh Kaya's Tasty Tale
description: Join Kaya on her quest to become a Worldbuilder in this heartwarming puzzle action-adventure. Explore the whimsical world of Selera, inspired by the rich cultures of Southeast Asia, where rhythm powers exploration, puzzles, and combat in a heartfelt tale of family, courage, and self-discovery.

title: Hey, Don't Look at Me
description: Hey, Don't Look at Me is a psychological first-person horror game where you'll observe ghosts through binoculars, investigate the circumstances of their deaths, and try to survive inside your own apartment. Just don't forget: sometimes, they're watching you too.

title: The Miracle Of San Martin
description:
A survival horror experience that mixes classic and modern elements, a story where faith meets fear.

Explore San Martín, a remote hispanic town where a missing girl, a pit in the outskirts, whispered miracles, unspeakable sins, and buried horrors, challenge everything a Priest believes.

title: CONQ: Crown of No Quarter
description: You were promised the heavens, but found only eternal purgatory -- unable to escape, unable to truly die. Gather your forces across sea and land, show no mercy, and give your enemies no quarter. It's time to bleed again.

title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
description: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

title: Last Wail of the Sea King
description: Explore the body of a dying sea beast in this first-person RPG with JRPG-inspired turn-based combat. Recruit bizarre companions, battle mutated creatures and uncover the secrets of the Sea King.

title: Prospera
description: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

title: Police Simulator
description: The latest entry in the Police Simulator franchise lets you build your career in Faremont City. Take on over 50 missions and callouts, patrol with a K9 partner, drive specialized police vehicles, and play solo or with a friend.

title: Conquista: Tide of Wills
description: Conquista a strategy game that blends colony sim w/ 4X gameplay. Build thriving cities and lead your nation to dominance. With living units who work, build relationships, and pursue ambitions of their own, you must respond to their desires. The seeds of history may be sown through one's dreams.

title: Brain Runner: Dreamcore Movement Shooter
description: Your time is running out. Kill to take it back. Sprint, wall-run, and shoot through shifting dream worlds in a fast-paced movement-shooter roguelite as Aina fights to wake humanity from the perfect dream.

title: Hotel Is Hungry
description: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, and feed the hotel before it decides to feed itself. One wrong room, someone dies. A body horror hotel management game.

title: Hyperdrop
description: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

title: Panic 64
description: Panic Porcupine returns in a high-speed 3D platformer that blends classic run n' jump mechanics with racing elements!

title: Deepward
description: Choose 3 heroes from a roster of six, each with distinct weapons, abilities, and playstyles. Build the right squad, switch between heroes on the fly, and fight relentless horrors in this fast-paced horror FPS roguelite set in the 1920s. Descend beneath a god-forsaken place where death is permanent.

title: Deltarune: Chapter 6
description: An upcoming chapter for Deltarune.

title: Cresata
description: Betrayed. Imprisoned. Left to die. Following a treacherous rebellion, Phaedon of Arsica is imprisoned and left for dead. Freed by a twist of fate, he now hunts down those who betrayed him and his homeland.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Rumble: Survivaton
description: Survive, Exorcise, Change the game JUJUTSU KAISEN RUMBLE: SURVIVATON is a survivors royale where you battle cursed spirits and rival sorcerers, growing stronger throughout the match. Outscore your rivals and fight to be the last player standing victorious.

title: Detective Turner: If Looks Could Kill
description: A text-driven noir murder mystery where you literally read the room. Search for clues in the text, photograph evidence, and interrogate suspects to solve the murder of fashion icon Margot Voss.

title: Floor Plan: Slap Out Of It!
description: A slap-and-solve adventure that stretches your wits and your noodly arms in all directions. Explore impossible towers where every floor is a comedy sandbox of secrets. Meet strange characters and solve (or add to) their problems with a personal touch. The power to change everything is in your hands.

title: Lazy River
description: A co-op adventure at the galaxy's most unregulated waterpark. Some guy peed in the pool, and the pee mixed with the space water and turned everybody into zombies… Except you and your friends. Build a raft, ride down the Lazy River, and escape before you run out of hot dogs!

title: N Plus Infinity Times Two
description: 5 fresh flavors of world-class online mayhem, from Friendship-Testing Co-op to Friendship-Ending Competitive, plus classic singleplayer. Run around with friends, lure enemies into opponents, make the ultimate sacrifice for teammates, and hunt each other with rockets. Couch-ready/Tournament-worthy.

title: R.override
description: Explore an alien planet as a fierce little rover on a run-based mission to rescue a lost crew and uncover their secrets.

title: Feed the Giants
description: You are a giant guiding a group of lost children through a hostile world. Help them… or sacrifice them to entertain your kind, who watch the spectacle from above. Some want to see them thrive, others crave their suffering. Every choice has its price.

title: Fallgrade
description: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

title: Last Floor: Paradox
description:
Last Floor is a first-person psychological horror game focused on observation and anomaly detection. The player navigates a looping hospital corridor and must identify subtle changes in the environment.

Each run begins in an elevator and progresses through an identical hallway. The player must determine whether an anomaly is present during the loop and choose the correct elevator direction to continue. Incorrect decisions reset progression.

An elevator that doesn't obey the laws of space. Descend through impossible places, spot anomalies, follow the rules, and survive whatever waits on the last floor.

title: Knuckle Paradise
description: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

title: Protocol: Zero-Day
description: Protocol: Zero-Day is a brutal and fast-paced Action-Roguelite set in a cyber-apocalyptic world. Wield your electric baton, master lightning-fast dashes, and survive endless hordes of corrupted anomalies. Navigate the shattered digital grid, upgrade your stats, and purge the system before you are overrun. Pure skill, zero compromises.

title: Brotato: Primal Dread
description: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

title: Crewcial
description: Join the craziest repair company in the space-time continuum! In this 2D party game, teamwork is everything: fix machines, manage heat and pressure, toss tools around, and climb the leaderboard, without losing your friendship!

title: Pikku Adventure
description: A challenging puzzle adventure about learning an alien language. Explore a strange world and meet its cute inhabitants. Decipher the language and earn their trust. With every word learned, you will uncover more secrets. Can you solve the mystery of this world and decide the fate of the Pikku?

title: Void Hunters
description: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

title: Sprkls.exe
description: sprkls.exe is a cute, melancholic story-driven adventure that unfolds entirely on your desktop.

title: Pecado: SD Card
description: Pecado is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

title: Azur
description: Azur is a fast-paced PvP survival FPS set on the French island of Belmas. Every time you respawn, complete missions, explore, and survive as long as possible to secure the best gear, with the risk of losing everything.

title: Amigo: The Broken Loop
description: AMIGO is a first-person narrative-driven psychological thriller that follows a woman, Julien, after the death of her friend. As she investigates the mysterious Focus on Dream corporation, Julien uncovers a distorted world of memories, puzzles, and secrets – where nothing is quite what it seems.

title: Mimi's Restaurant helper
description: 2000's anime style restaurant game meets Wario ware , a game about making dishes and multitasking but with cute 2D art and beautiful bossanova music, Chaotic meets Cozy

title: Every Wednesday
description: When Hideki steps inside for the first time, he does not yet realize that this is where he will finally stop feeling invisible after a long time. Meet new friends alongside him, uncover their stories, and support them through life’s challenges. They might even help you rewrite your own story …

title: Forza Horizon 6: Premium Edition
description: Forza Horizon 6 Premium Edition includes the full game with Early Access - Play 4 days early starting May 15, and VIP Membership, Welcome Pack, Time Attack Car Pack, and Car Pass (30 cars delivered to your game, one per week), as well as the Italian Passion Car Pack and two Premium Expansions coming post-launch.

title: Forza Horizon 6: Deluxe Edition
description: Forza Horizon 6 Deluxe Edition includes the full game, Welcome Pack and Car Pass (30 cars delivered to your game, one per week).

title: Your Painting, Sir
description: Recreate paintings using newspaper cutouts - Analyze the painting, search the newspaper for similar elements, carefully cut them out, and place them on their correct position. Will you fool your boss with your arts and crafts?

title: Incoherence: Dark Rooms
description: Dark Rooms is a survival horror room-drafting game set in a looping nightmare. Expand the map by placing rooms at the cost of stability. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, manage limited resources, and unlock new rooms and upgrades. Every run is a new descent into darkness.

title: A Game About Breaking A Cube
description: Take a role of a factory worker opressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facilty and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with the cold can of drinkable meat.

title: Quantum Quartz
description: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles!

title: Pine Creek
description: A weekend getaway to Pine Creek in '86 turns into a nightmare when your wife vanishes as strange lights appear in the sky. Solve puzzles, hide from the grays, save Sarah and survive the night in this first-person stealth survival horror. The truth is darker than you think.

title: Ruin: Beast City
description: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

title: Flask
description: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

title: Ultrasound
description: A sci-fi horror 3D point&click game. Use an ultrasound machine to diagnose and do surgery on a grotesque infection spreading aboard a space freighter. Craft meds, upgrade your machine, find new surgical tools, and restore ship systems before you collide with a star. Soon, something will be born.

title: Project ReMind
description: "Welcome to the end. My end" Manipulate machinery, open secret passages and bypass computers to remember your life, from your first discovery to your own death bed. In this first-person narrative puzzle game investigate a mysterious presence looking for the answer that haunted you since THAT day.

title: The Secret of Weepstone
description: In a hand-drawn black and white dungeon crawler RPG inspired by classic D&D of the 80’s - Roll Dice, Fight Monsters, Loot Dungeons, Embrace Death, and unravel The Secret of Weepstone.

title: Kiipluu
description:
Kiipluu is a hardcore stealth adventure set in a brutal Neolithic world.

Every encounter is a tense survival puzzle. Study patrol routes, use tall grass, shadows, sound, and terrain to stay hidden. Set traps, strike from ambush, or slip past unseen. Being discovered can quickly become fatal.

When stealth fails, combat is fast, brutal, and unforgiving. Weapons are primitive. Injuries matter. There are no easy victories.

Along the way, Kiipluu is haunted by dreamlike spirit journeys and visions of his father, a legendary hunter whose shadow looms over every choice. Your decisions shape who survives, who is lost, and what kind of person Kiipluu becomes.

This is a story of fear, survival, and growing up in a world that wants you dead.

title: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
description:
A long-lost 2D pixel art RPG returns across time.
Originally completed two decades ago but never released, this hidden gem is now being faithfully rebuilt by KOHACHI STUDIO for Nintendo Switch.
Set in ancient Japan, you play as Navinosuke, a young onmyoji-in-training, meeting and battling over 150 unique yokai.
Plan your tactics using turn-based auto battles and a shikigami system, and explore a whimsical, strategy-driven Japanese fantasy world.

title: Coming Home
description: A retro slasher horror game, with a focus on home defense. In the dead of night, you hear someone lurking outside - but you are not defenseless. Watch the cameras, barricade your doors, and have your gun at the ready - anything to keep the Sundown Rippers from claiming their next victim.

title: Unsound Love
description: An open-world horror escape room where nothing is explained. You are born into a new world through the backseat of a wrecked car. Trapped in a time loop. Understand it — or stay trapped forever.

title: End of Ember
description: Explore a gory Hell in this twin-stick shooter that pays homage to badass horror franchises. Kill demons, upgrade items, and fight weird and gross bosses until they explode in piles of gore. Who is Ember? What is reality?

title: Lemonade Apocalypse
description: Make money selling lemonade. Optimise your product. Build your workforce. Sell, sell, sell. But money is not enough. Become president! Fuel climate change! Manipulate geopolitical events! Lemonade Apocalypse is an incremental game about business decisions that are technically legal.

title: Broken Relic
description: On his first day as an archive intern, Tim unleashes an ancient conqueror and gets fired. Now the boss who fired him is relying on him to save the world. A fully voiced fantasy point-and-click comedy.

title: Sacrata
description: A dark-themed Roguelike survivor game where you must withstand relentless waves of enemies, craft powerful skill builds, unlock new survivors, and take on dark bosses. Claim sacred artifacts and experience an unparalleled thrill of intense combat and ultimate destruction!

title: Artius: Pure Imagination
description: Artius is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as four unique artists fighting to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction. Dash, swing, and smash your way through vibrant, hand-drawn worlds inspired by art!

title: Aether & Iron
description: Immerse yourself in this narrative RPG set in an alternate 1930s where anti-gravitational technology has taken cars, roads, and even New York City into the sky. Muster a crew, master tactical, turn-based combat, and unravel the dark secrets lurking beneath the floating metropolis.

title: Retro Game Store Simulator
description: Build your own Video Game Store in 1984. Everyday until the end of 1989 gives you the opportunity to stock shelves, cycle your inventory, manage your prices, analyze historical trends to make your game store profitable. Use era-relevant technology and systems to prove that gaming has a future!

title: Threat Vector
description: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

title: The Dropouts
description: Heist your own school to get the exams' answers and discover why so many students have disappeared in Noirmont High. Spooky and nostalgic.

title: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover
description: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

title: Rottenroots
description: Rottenroots is a branching narrative role-playing game set in a dystopian world where conformity means survival. Guide Salem through moral dilemmas, time-pressured choices, and dynamic character interactions. Your decisions shape his personality, relationships, and fate in this gripping story.

title: Avante! Atlantis
description: Avante! Atlantis is a turn-based strategy game with a board game aesthetic. Capture territory, deploy units, and outmaneuver rivals in tactical battles. Every move counts as you fight for control of a resurged land rich in resources...and full of secrets.

title: Sick Samurai
description: Sick Samurai is a blindingly fast and bloody action game based on instant-death combat. Immerse yourself in lofi hip hop and retro anime aesthetics as you slash and dash your way to becoming the greatest fighter on the island.

title: Art Shop Simulator
description: Buy and sell art, manage employees, and grow your shop in this immersive simulator set in Europe. Curate a unique collection, attract customers, and become the premier art dealer. Transform your humble gallery into a thriving art empire!

title: Battle Vision
description: Battle your way to fame and glory in this cosmic tactical puzzle-battle roguelike! Recruit your ultimate team, equip them with powerful abilities and take them on a season-long run of domination in the universe’s most-watched battle-sport!

title: Bestiario
description: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

title: Lair Of The Leviathan
description: Journey through a large open world with a party of heroes exploring dungeons, villages and mysteries. Manage an adventuring party of heroes and choose the way their stories evolve as they journey through a non linear epic adventure towards the ultimate Lair of the Leviathan.

title: Polda 8
description: It´s the eight entry in the point and click adventure series Polda and the final game with Pankrác as the main character. Just like previous entries is this one focused on puzzles and crazy humor, however this time there are also action minigames and three controlable characters.

title: Unyverse
description: Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse delivers an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience for single and co-op players enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.

title: Infinity Knights: Xross
description: A King and his Infinity Knights wield The Armaments - weapons capable of reviving slain enemies. Xross, the newest Infinity Knight, will embark on a life-changing adventure as he experiences both the thrill and dark reality of what it means to be eternal.

title: World of Warcraft: The Last Titan
description: The third of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

title: Project Mix
description: Project Mix is a VR anime cyberpunk bartending visual novel. What will you do when you've lost everything you once had?

title: The Last General
description: Lead your army through raging conflicts in this massive RTS modern war game. Execute tactics and conquer the resources you need to achieve your goals. Take the enemy territory, perform assassinations, lead insurrections, rescue your stranded troops and much more, in millions of different missions.

title: Beaten Path
description: Beaten Path is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a world ruled by fallen gods and ancient machines. Take command of Panna and her companions as they unravel the secrets of time, confronting lost memories, mythic powers, and a looping fate.

title: Paper Perjury
description:
Investigating a simple robbery reveals a tapestry of mysteries!

Solve a series of cases as newly hired police clerk Justina Smith and find out the truth behind a string of suspicious crimes. Work with the energetic detective Ernest Hunt and dig for clues in the paper trail to discover the secrets that paperwork can hide.

title: Blackout: Zero Point
description: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

title: Just in Crime
description: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

title: Fae & Fauna
description: Fae & Fauna is an open world pet collecting role-playing game. Collect magical creatures in undiscovered lands and fight with your companions against the dangers lurking in the wilds!

title: Gilded Destiny
description: Gilded Destiny is a grand strategy game depicting the transformative era of the Industrial Revolution. You will take the helm of the country of your choice and transform it from a backward agrarian society to an industrial powerhouse.

title: WorldShards
description: WorldShards is a Sandbox-RPG with a levelless progress system. Explore the mysterious fantasy world of Murrlandia, solve its mysteries, and help its tiny inhabitants to rebuild their home!

title: Trinity Archetype
description: Trinity Archetype is a roguelike turn-based RPG where you craft skills as you go! Mix and match dozens of runes, boost it up in battle and unleash devastating combos to reclaim your broken world.

title: Tremen
description: Fight the hordes of mutants that enslaved humanity through a concrete brutalist hell in this FPS with modern graphics and old school gameplay.

title: They Speak From the Abyss
description:
Venture into the Abyss and face strange and horrifying monsters in this bone chilling RPG.

With the spirit Sophia at your side, you must venture into the nightmare-ish world of the Abyss in order to escape. Monsters will block your path, will you be strong enough to conquer them, or will you perish and join the other lost souls who roam the depths.

title: Clock Overwhelmed
description: Organize tasks within your routine, but be careful not to overlap activities and get overwhelmed!

title: CottageCore
description: CottageCore is a cozy village-building sim. Players shape cottages and towers, choose their materials and colors, and add details such as doors, windows, chimneys, lanterns and ivy, with buildings that can even float on clouds. Deer, rabbits, sheep and chickens live, breed and age in a living ecosystem shaped by weather and seasons, while fifteen connected trades, from lumberjacks and farmers to bakers, keep the village supplied. The game offers a Creative mode with every trade unlocked, and a God of the Glade mode where a shared mana reserve, restored by happy villagers and decorated homes, powers villagers, animals, trees and supplies.

title: Prima Materia
description: Prima Materia is a dark surreal visual novel set in a sterilized wasteland ruled by Angels, where consciousness is harvested, brewed, and sold. Mana, a Mind Digger who survives by eating minds, takes one last job: fixing a demi-angel worth keeping whole.

title: Dokapon Kingdom: Connect 2
description: An all-new entry in the Dokapon series, the RPG-style board game you can enjoy with up to four players! Take on gigantic monsters together, and create your very own hero with the Character Creation system! Friendship or betrayal? Money or power? Sacrifice your friendships and seize victory!

title: Heroes Never Die
description: Choose your hero, rally your troops, and carve a path through hordes of foul creatures in a fast-paced fusion of strategy and survivor gameplay. Grow your army as you march, change your tactics on the fly, and lead soldiers, goblins, minotaurs and more into glorious, chaotic battle.

title: Dress Your Meat
description: Dress Your Meat is a cooking horror game where you work at a dumpling restaurant. Take orders, prepare dishes, and do your best to keep your chef happy. Sounds simple enough, until things in the kitchen start getting seriously disturbing.

title: Monster Prom 5: Monster Retreat
description: Get ready for the ultimate winter war in this hilarious narrative adventure with dashes of strategy and romance! Visit snowy locations, recruit from a pool of over 80 wacky characters onto your team, and destroy your opponents in a fierce snowball fight to the death. Oh, and date hot monsters too

title: Love is a Roguelite
description: A turn-based tactical deck-building roguelite where heartbreak makes you stronger. Craft absurd card synergies, outsmart procedural dungeons, and romance your partner across a fracturing timeloop to restore their lost memories—one run at a time.

title: SubDuctis
description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again

title: NAND²
description: Build a computer from a single NAND gate: wire relays into logic, memory and a 16-bit CPU with a pipeline, branch prediction and a cache, then program it. Robots in mazes, Nim, even a shooter on your own CPU. A long campaign through the eras of computing, plus a level editor and Steam Workshop.

title: Rex Summons a Meteor
description: A short game about a large rock. You helped a wizard wish on a shooting star, and got a meteor instead. Every dinosaur talks in emoji: work out what each one wants, find it, and play absurd mini-games like skateboarding and rhythm duets. No timer, no game over. Now go save the dinosaurs.

title: Warstead
description: Build your base, secure vital resources, and lead your troops into battle. Warstead combines base building with tactical real-time combat. Will you invest in your economy, strengthen your defenses—or launch an attack?

title: Hex Party
description: 「Hex Party」 is a lighthearted company management × romance sim. A mysterious mark and a strange curse suddenly appear, while your company faces a crisis. As the CEO, can you save your company and break the curse? Make your choices and create your own story.

title: Frostmason
description: Hunt monsters for their body parts. Assemble them into a full specimen as part of a Cold War project

title: Little Prince Tyger
description: Combine archery and simulated physics in single screen levels in this violent action roguelike. By order of the Queen, hunt and do not question it.
